Update-status, log-tail and schedule-list reads run off the event loop.

`/api/state` adds `current_questions`/`main_attention` and the work projection (`works`, `rooms`), each with completeness and typed gaps (§3); `active_chat_activities` stays root-only. GET neither scans chat nor writes; requests share one display publication, rebuilt only when its revision moved (`gateway/state_publication.py`), never an authority; actions reuse `/api/decisions` and task endpoints.

#### WebSocket protocol

`/ws` delivers live browser events; the queue, task, Project, review, skill, settings, cost and update owners persist the truth a reconnecting client rebuilds from REST and history. `gateway/ws.py` admits JSON objects, owned extension namespaces, `command` text, `chat` text/attachments. Chat acceptance (row → queue → echo) runs off-loop (`gateway._helpers.run_sync_to_completion`). Each socket chains its chats in receive order, unawaited, so Panic and Restart stay responsive behind a held chat (§5 Bridge intake); disconnect waits for received chats to settle (`settle_to_completion`). Public sockets never carry Host Service or owned-daemon tokens.

Feature subscriptions and the initial Project chat-id lookup precede the first socket open; that lookup can fail. Every decoded frame emits `message`, then its type-specific event, including reviewed namespaced events for Widgets.

##### WebSocket chat

A browser `chat` frame carries owner text and/or uploads, optional `sender_session_id`, `client_message_id`, `chat_id`, `project_id` and `client_surface` measured at send (the native bridge loads asynchronously). The host resolves `reply_to`; optional `reply_excerpt` records the sender’s selection. The gateway normalizes the surface with `client_surface.normalize_client_surface`, stamps `received_at` and shares `LocalChatBridge.enqueue_local_message` with other transports. Promotion and steering carry the originating message’s surface; the chat’s `transport` selects the reply route.

Same `client_message_id` retries rejoin only identical words, ordered attachments and Reply (address and excerpt). Echo (`ingress_accepted`) and history show dispatch: retry/bus init dispatches `ingress_pending` once; `ingress_dispatched` has entered. On unreadable history nothing is claimed or written (`supervisor/message_ingress.py`). `initialization_notice` correlates refusals; it also explains an unusable source or conflicting id without reporting a boot failure.

Offline frames queue in memory; overflow drops the oldest, reload clears it. Uploads use `queue:false`; a failed write releases new uploads. A taken send, selected reply included, frees the field; a file it uploaded and a newer draft still stages keeps its ref. `createUnconfirmedSends` keeps non-command frames by ID with citation and upload refs (no file bytes). Echo/history settles that ID; “Send again” reuses its frame, “Discard” drops it, a selected reply's “Send as new” returns its words and quote to an empty composer.

Off-loop acceptance confines attachment specs to upload-root basenames bound to measured `size`/`sha256`, so bytes swapped under the path afterwards are rejected rather than staged; model pixels come only from staged files. The web owner identity is fixed: `chat_id` selects a thread and cannot mint an external owner identity.

A `command` frame routes through the bridge without rebroadcast; authorization, queue authority and outcomes remain outside the socket module. Panic bypasses the queue on the existing connection (§9); other header controls keep ordinary command routing. Prose never implies a command (BIBLE P5).

##### Frame addressing

Outbound envelope types: `gateway.contracts.WS_MESSAGE_TYPES` minus the inbound `command`. `update_progress_changed` invalidates the update observation, never proving boot completion. Chat progress carries additive presentation facts (`ChatOutbound` in `GET /api/contract`); an absent optional field never means no receipt, cost or result.

Project panels take chat, typing, media and log frames by `chat_id` or `also_rooms`; Main follows §3. `projects_changed` extends the tab's known ids before fetch. The bus stamps `project_thread` by registry membership, not ID range; Telegram stays unstamped. `chat_activity.mainThreadAccepts` honors a web `room_echo` as a display address only (CLIENT_CONTRACT §5). `supervisor/log_addressing.py::address_task_event` stamps task log audiences at ingress: explicit 0 is `HIDDEN_CHAT_ID`, not missing. Conversation turns carry the address by value since queued events can outlive a turn row. `message_annotation` updates one canonical owner message without another bubble; `task_named` only updates an existing card.

Extension WebSocket traffic is namespaced by `extension_loader.extension_surface_name()`, so an extension cannot shadow a built-in type. Each incoming extension frame resolves its owning skill and rechecks that the extension is still desired, reviewed, granted, enabled and live; out-of-process handlers run in their extension child off the event loop. A missing or failed handler never ends the socket loop (replies and error frames: CLIENT_CONTRACT §5).

Each socket has one writer and outbox (`ws._Connection`), so a slow or half-open browser delays only itself; a broadcast is encoded once, for open sockets only, one loop wake per burst (`ws.py`). A failed send retires its socket and writes `broadcast_partial_failure` off the loop; the domain event stays owned by its durable producer.

##### Reconnect and recovery

The browser reconnects with bounded exponential delay; a watchdog closes a silent seemingly-open socket. One served-page decision (`ws.js decideServedPage`) governs the post-open read and the socket-down probe, so a transient drop keeps in-page state. The core attests only pages it serves: without `served_ui` (an older core), or for its marked page while it serves builtin, `decide()` reloads on a changed or unprovable SHA and keeps the page and its queued frames on an unchanged one or an unversioned `/api/state` with no remembered SHA (possibly stale assets); the marked page reloads once after a restart applied a directory or `none`; an unmarked page owns its refresh and only reconnects. A failed/non-OK read never reloads (a seconds-old server can answer 500). Four healthy probes reload only a page that connected, once per disconnect episode; an attempt failing after one is `serverAnswersWhileDown`: an observation, not a cause.

Each Chat instance handles `open` by resynchronizing durable history (a reconnect adds no feed row) and `close` by withdrawing online and accounting presentation; deduplication covers the overlap between live frames and REST replay, and large history parsing runs off the server event loop. Not every transient frame is persisted: durable chat rows, task results, queue snapshots, Project revisions, review/cost ledgers and lifecycle state remain the recovery authorities.


## 5. Supervisor Loop

`server.py::_run_supervisor()` owns the pooled scheduling tick and lifecycle lock. Intent precedes teardown; intent, outcome and money stay separate.

#### Tick and locks

Each tick publishes liveness, rotates logs, checks workers, drains one bounded batch in one round trip (`ObservedEventQueue.drain`), control before telemetry, so no answer waits (`event_taxonomy.EventDisposition.lane`), takes bridge input (a backlog skips wait and idle sleep), projects money, enforces due deadlines (`enforce_due_task_timeouts`), runs maintenance, admits/assigns, feeds the queue publisher (`start_queue_writer`), ticks consciousness and writes a busy minute's `supervisor_load` row (`loop_load.py`; Q per site). A lost bus (`EventBusLost`, read first; `bus_lost`) or three straight failures on a live bus, publication included (`loop_failed`), end a ready generation (`server_process.end_generation_on_fault`; §9 Fault door); shutdown excepted (`_SignalStopServer`).

`supervisor/event_observation.py` indexes pending idle inputs across both lanes and holds outstanding-delivery membership (`put_unless_outstanding`); `event_taxonomy.py` names the reducers changing idle inputs. Pending inputs defer idle observations without granting progress or a lease; heartbeats, telemetry and host narration cannot suppress attention indefinitely; dequeue certifies no failed handler's effects.

`state.json` money is display, not admission (§10.28): totals persist, `usage_projection` owns per-root values, `usage_writer_snapshot` renders once per dirty tick after intake. Ledger `(compaction_epoch, seq)` ordering rejects stale renders. Quarantine (`integrity_degraded`) freezes display until explicit repair; failed writes stay dirty until `BUDGET_PROJECTION_RETRY_SEC`. The async OpenRouter comparison never changes admission.

`supervisor.queue._queue_lock` (Q) owns queue transitions; `task_admission` reserves identity before effects (§1). Admission persists nothing under Q: child receipts, launch marks and warm Resumes reserve memory there, persist on the generation's admission lane (`PreparationGeneration.wait_store`: a slice per attempt, controls re-read between, never behind a copy), re-take Q, compare memory, then put; a later refusal settles the row typed; an uncertain write is inspected, not re-sent. Closed, it starts nothing; paused, no launch, yet committed marks reach a worker: process-ending stops pause it and wait before reading the queue or writing restrictions (`pause_admission`); a longer stall, a refusal or error after its marks, or Panic leaves one possibly dispatched. A cold root's live tree keeps its lanes (§6). Other outer-lock probes use `store.acquisition_budget(0)`: confirmed contention defers unsent work off locks, unknown grants nothing. Only Evolution has mode fences. `execution_owner.kind` is the origin, its `lane`/`executor` the carrier and carrier policy; `_is_direct_chat` is historical. First `detached_at`/`detached_by` survive queue/result metadata.

`dispatch_choice.py` selects only work reusable/admissible capacity can carry, using the launch's own gates; launch still revalidates. Queue order, gate costs, identity reuse, repair and residuals: its module docstring.

#### Admission and addressing

Headless addressing is fixed at admission (`log_addressing.ingress_chat_id`). A registered Project's explicit `chat_id` must match its thread; any other address, hidden included, gets a typed 400, so a Main card never detaches from its Project work. Without a Project, API tasks default to `HIDDEN_CHAT_ID` (0). Confirmed browser Publish requests Main with `source="web"`/`WEB_UI_CHAT_ID` (caller-declared addressing, not authentication); other non-Project addresses are refused. Main gets one host-stamped completion only for work addressed or bound there; other work stays hidden: silent in chats, readable via terminal, `--result-json-out`, Logs and `GET /api/tasks/<id>`. Reserved inactive Projects keep their chat valid for the queue's typed lifecycle refusal.

Admission names use no model; `task_named` never titles by status. Authored `title` (`ouroboros run --title`/top-level contract/schedule name) fills `title`/`suggested_name`; `metadata.title`/`metadata.project_id` get 400. First-line fallback (owner/API/queued events, or what a late-input head answers) fills only `suggested_name`, keeping later names. `start_task` needs a root title for separate new work; old routing cards resolve.

`queue_publication.py` writes and `queue_observation.py` reads outside Q (§10.24). Atomic replacement confirms dispatch fences. Tightening can precede the snapshot. Relaxation follows its durable write. Exact parks and automatic grants publish after Q releases and compare pause, state and grant. At boot `work_stop_migration.py` converts legacy stops and `queue_snapshot.py` recovers interrupted direct parks from indexed pause rows and saved envelopes. Empty processes and concurrent restores keep unread work. Continue waits for custody. Stop and terminals govern retained rows. Other caught roots stay fenced with their pending children (§6, §9). Spent grants yield to current custody.

`_claim_worker_launch` reserves the row and the slot under Q; the lane reads the schedule control, then puts only after the dispatch marks commit in one write, before anything says `possible` (`_commit_launch`); snapshots never replay a put. Contention is demand: the lane retries the same row, attempt and marks; a refusal frees the slot, the row stays demand. Dispatch, hold release and deadline expiry read the loop's `governing_continuation`; saved successors need the frozen source and prior `admitted_dispatch_attempt` (§6). Proven no-put callers bind source/attempt/claim to terminalization, rechecked by the reaper; terminal rows stay terminal; accepted/sealed roots' descendants stay fenced except exact pauses. `task_status.execution_observation` keeps fresh activity apart from lifecycle; only pooled work admits worker-boot orphan inference.

`workspace_preparation` admits children off the event thread. Memory is claimed first: copies take the copy lane with preparation-time bytes, readonly or receipt-then-put admissions the admission lane. Requests are never re-put. On store contention only the chosen refusal receipt retries, not preparation, disposal or notification. Neither child-count pre-check (worker `schedule_subagent`, early supervisor) refuses an unknown count; the interlocked `control_delegation.schedule_delegation_refusal` decides. At startup and reconciliation `recover_interrupted_preparations` settles proven loss as never admitted and keeps uncertain admissions (§10.19). `forward_to_worker` reaches requested children. Entry: `events_schedule_task`, `task_admission`.

#### Schedules and follow-ups

`queue_schedules.py` alone writes `state/scheduled_tasks.json` under `schedule_transaction` (Q then sidecar; PERSISTENCE). `load_schedule_store`: only absence is empty; `ScheduleStoreUnreadable` means no mutation, unknown reads. `schedule_lifecycle._stamp_text_authors` stamps each changed field's supplier from the locked preimage; lifecycle/no-op keeps it. `/api/schedules` ignores client author/corpus copies and reports `ignored_fields`, never attesting them.

`schedule_occurrence.py` freezes one root/receipt per occurrence; `hold` waits, not fails. Restart keeps token/task identity: positive `possible` holds, proven-unsent replays, missing/foreign/unreadable stays unknown. Edits affect unaccepted work; accepted tasks survive restorable withdrawal. Cron keeps one overdue occurrence. `schedule_notes.py` consumes `kind:"notify"` once, showing signed System `reminder`; unconfirmed display sets `last_error`, never retries. Frozen objective/context ride `owner_words.SCHEDULE_TEXT` through inputs, Continue, helpers, review and Safety as assignment/conditions, never personal owner words or new permission.

`followup_policy.py` requires explicit related/independent relationship, never inferred from provenance/billing; owner words ride by value, related work keeps origin cap/source/deadline. Missing/stale queue evidence holds. Restart dates, never holds healthy schedules. Finite audited refresh accepts legacy Restart holds (disabled settled too), removes only Restart, keeps history/owed occurrences and recomputes mixed identities. GET projects. Stop writes `followup_stop` on the original result even if completion wins; `stop_action_id` is ingress, not custody `request_id` (CLIENT_CONTRACT §8). `expected_hold_id` releases only that hold; generic Restore may re-enable/cancel deletion. `schedule_mutation` intent/outcome share `operation_id`; failure reports `changed_audit_incomplete`, never unaudited rollback. Tools/API share action/reason (`schedule_lifecycle`). Scans adopt legacy skill rows, cache `last_outcome`/`previous_run_open` (PERSISTENCE); other disabled idle rows skip admission. Observe off Q; publish checks row/Restart generation. Reconciliation/binding repair/GC use signed `task_ownership` receipts, rechecking versions under Q: changed/busy defers, unknown stays unknown. Admission verifies its committed write; writes/final controls hold Q.

#### Completion, owner waits and restarts

Workers prepare files before `task_done`; its stamp never replaces CURRENT readiness (`headless.terminal_task_files_ready`). Capture needs `ARTIFACT_TERMINAL_STATUSES`; blank/unknown stays owed, failed/missing grants no PASS. Readers and preparation share `task_requires_workspace_capture`: no workspace, readonly subagents and inline executors are exempt after terminal-source verification and split adoption; cancellation wins. `CustodyBusy` keeps RUNNING and `pending_drives` for health/startup recovery, fork or not. Recovery neither replays the model nor scans history.

Answer first: `agent_task_pipeline.emit_task_results` owes and live-enqueues the root final BEFORE cost reconstruction, review evidence/input capture and `_store_task_result`; `task_done` follows that store. Carrier ordering and `task_finalization_timing` (`basis: post_answer_store`): `finalization_timing.emit_post_answer_timing`. Timeout/dead-worker recovery adopts owed, exhausted, delivered or unreadable registrations; direct boot-fence custody needs a readable registration (`working_checkpoint.adopt_registered_answer`). Adoption keeps the answer with `failed`/`infra_failed`/`finalization_incomplete` and a host notice, never replays the prompt.

`worker_owner_wait` keeps task, worker and browser RUNNING; a parked task does not act; `grant_warm_returns` returns it on its own worker without a capacity grant, even above the owner's cap, never holding, silencing or killing another process for it (transaction, retry and clocks: module docstring). Main/Project waits survive planned restart with unread input; mail wakes, only owner answers answer. Settled post-work rejects steering (`owner_mailbox.mailbox_drain_ended`). Lane carriers wait here too; only inline executors use `owner_wait.direct_owner_wait`.

Crashes, timeouts, restart and update-abort use §6 Saved working state.

#### Cancellation

Intent precedes custody; intent and outcome are separate fields (§10.14–15):

1. **Intent.** Ingresses (`cancel_task`, HTTP single/cascade, evolution stop, project deletion, cascade sweep, ended work's parked-helper closure, boot recovery of `cancel_requested` files) use `cancel_intents.request_cancel` to write one durable locked row in `state/cancel_intents.json`. Failed writes stop nothing (`CANCEL_INTENT_WRITE_FAILED`, HTTP 503).
2. **Scope.** Recorded scope only widens (single to cascade; Stop-now cannot shrink a cascade). Reaping is no cancel ingress: its custody survives health hand-back until replay settles. Stop needs explicit intent; a replay in flight keeps it pending.
3. **Claim.** `task_lifecycle.cancel_task_custody` claims exclusively (§10.14): racing custodies never double-settle; `cancel_task` only wakes it. Custody/boot restore may withdraw obsolete helper closures without cancelling. Lane turns stop like workers; inline actors get one typed `finalize_now` (`inline_carrier.stop_direct_chat_turn`), ending next round boundary without another model call. Stop during post-task synthesis records skipped paid stages in `post_task_stop_reason`. Live turns release their claim for the sweep without publishing `cancelled`.
4. **Kill and re-check.** Custody confirms process death, then rereads the settled result; natural completion wins (§10).
5. **Reconcile, capture, settle.** Re-audit open delegated runs from durable custody; capture workspace artifacts from the real tree (failed or unrunnable: `failed`, not `missing`). The result records reconstructed or unknown cost, never a fabricated `$0`. Only settlement stamps `parent_decision`; `cancel_publication` keeps `cancel_origin`, restore-fence receipts name its cause. `supervisor_cancel` dates the observed cancellation, including Evolution before assignment, not process death. HTTP proves transport, not owner intent.
6. **Owe, then publish.** Recheck the claim. Owe the answer before the terminal row, settled intent and `task_done` (pending deadlines under lock). Winning completion withdraws salvage. A crash replays debt. Cascades send one `cascade:<root_tid>:<request_id>` digest. Any owed final, cancel or cascade holds Done. Project and Main bind failure and its copy to the answer and chat. Unbound exhaustion and unreadable receipts stay visible (`terminal_projection.py`, `events_chat_delivery._handoff_delivered_review`).
7. **Watchdog.** The off-drain tick sweep (`server_maintenance.py`, `sweep_cancel_intents`) re-feeds unclaimed/abandoned intents to custody (cascades as cascades): a lost control event or custody dead mid-teardown cannot wedge cancellation.

Effective results show typed `cancel_state: "pending"` with `cancel_reason` until settlement (§3). Steering writes (`tell_task`, mailbox follow-ups, `forward_to_worker`) are refused typed while pending; restore and pre-assignment read the projection under Q, so a cancelled pending task never starts. `task_done` asserts a settled outcome validated against the durable result (`events_task_done`); a mismatch is a lifecycle fault, left to custody while cancellation is pending.

`terminal_delivery.py` owns the outbox: exact-id debt before enqueue, boot/tick replay; refusal keeps debt (PERSISTENCE.md). Producers use the injected bus; queued/in-flight originals neither duplicate nor spend retries (`put_unless_outstanding`, process claims). Exhausted rows keep payload and copy until receipt. A delivered Stop receipt supersedes its task's older `host_notice` final in that chat, never resent, whatever prior sends did. Card dedupe probes task/summary id/readiness token in `dialog.sqlite`; importing misses stay owed. Main's frozen event/clock survives eviction until strict receipt (§3). Cancel sends lineage-routed unreviewed salvage; a reap only without a held answer. Receipt proves neither display nor reading (§10).

Best-effort dialogue tries zero wait, publishing live at the same timestamp; a contended row waits in `dialogue_retry`, which crash or sustained contention can lose (bounds, drains, dedup: PERSISTENCE.md). Required rows and named inbound acceptances never use it; inbound failure stays loud.

Named sends keep timestamp/id; unnamed notices keep their producer; `emitted` facts/id cache repair receipts without resend (earlier crash: at-least-once). Only non-Main replays count durable dispatch entries (`message_bus`, after required writes, unknown outcomes too); queueing only dates backoff.

#### Stop policy and hurry

Stop policy is a durable-intent axis, scope-independent; omission is immediate (CLIENT_CONTRACT §8). `finalize_then_cancel` answers 202, intent open: descendants settle first, no final turn; then root `finalize_now` allows one tool-less turn under the honest owner reason (`supervisor/owner_stop.py`). `owner_stop_receipt.py` keeps child/run material and readers in the custody envelope: the turn's counted view, one card row per Stop, Files' on-read copy of all rows/texts, on any exit; model bytes untouched; no session transfer. `OWNER_STOP_OUTER_CAP_SEC`, deadline, ceiling bound grace. Immediate only hardens graceful; Panic bypasses both.

Owner "hurry" is a typed task-local `kind=hurry` owner-mailbox control (`ouroboros/owner_hurry.py`; `gateway/task_hurry.py`): it wakes a waiting task, lets delivery skip just-arrived review answers and gives the work one line asking to finish sooner; never a chat message, settings mutation or weakening of the P3 commit/review gates; attempt-scoped (`retry_reset` strips it on each same-id requeue).

#### Event bus, timeouts and worker readiness

One server-owned, process-lifetime manager bus serves worker generations/inline actors/non-task review usage. Respawn never rotates it; lookup cannot create it, producer exit cannot close it, a killed producer cannot corrupt another feeder frame. Its `spawn` manager ignores SIGINT/SIGTERM; each `get_event_q` reads its exit code, raising `EventBusLost`. `log_addressing.task_event_queue` stamps chat/lineage/attempt by value: late telemetry stays addressed. Workers attempt checkpoint storage before one live frame (`loop_messages._emit_checkpoint_event`); the nested handler persists only `task_start_settings_reload_failed`. `utils.append_jsonl` streams `logs/*.jsonl` except dedicated-sender types (worker/server) and `live=False` copies: one live frame/event; `llm_api_error` in drive and canonical log.

Heartbeat proves liveness only, dated by its own source time (never before its attempt), reading no store (`_handle_task_heartbeat`). `silence_attention` dates the episode on the row and the task document and mails the source and one waiting ancestor (late warm/cold/in-slot waits too); only the source's own progress ends it. No host role is minted for it: whoever waits decides. The RUNNING row carries the fact into the work projection, whose line leads with `No recorded progress since …` while the episode is open (reason `no_progress`). Without an ancestor that waits and reads its mail, no mind is told, on any install, consciousness included; a stuck work never reaches the step at which it would read its own mail.

Deadlines and finite execution bounds freeze under Q, mark `reaping` and enter `task_reaper`; queued deadlines expire undispatched; kill/join precede salvage and settlement. Unconfirmed death keeps custody without terminalization, retry or replacement; `task_reaper_wedged` suggests Restart. A result file proves no process exit; typed incidents keep `TIMEOUT_TERMINAL_REASONS` identity.

`worker_pool_lifecycle.pool_slot_counts` separates acting tasks and idle/booting/sleeping processes; cold sleepers have none (§6); the cap: §7. `pool_admission.py` owns physical admission and dated facts: confirmed critical pressure holds new processes, floor included; running work continues. Its docstring specifies measurements, fences and unknown readings.

The conversation spare starts first; project workers have no spare and grow only for rows the pass chose and no idle worker took; surplus retires, no idle timer (idle memory over burst startup). Startup verification and bytecode storage: PERSISTENCE.md; `worker_boot` remains per process. Unchanged skills reuse catalogs/digests (§13). `booting` slots are capacity, unresolved reservations stay charged.

Assignment/free counts require current live readiness (`worker_pool_lifecycle.py` docstring). With no healthy slot, pooled ingress closes (`/review` too); `disable_exhausted_worker_pool` fails unstarted rows with a Restart hint, sparing chat, control, boot and update recovery.

Surplus retires only after local-work quiescence and confirmed death, keeping services; unknown defers, no history scans. The off-loop reservation/token/serializer protocol: `request_worker_quiescence`, `retire_quiescent_worker`, `reap_idle_worker` docstrings. No rotation or setting; intentional retirement is not a crash.

`worker_health.recover_confirmed_dead_worker` reserves `confirmed_dead_worker` custody under Q; a refused respawn is logged when it starts, changes cause and ends. Saved terminals (`task_exception` included) beat a death; exact pauses re-park (§6); unknown/incomplete publication stays `TerminalFileRecoveryPending`. Only confirmed absence reaches `infra_failed`, keeping answer/review/cost. Only a recorded stop terminalizes; an unrecorded death, signals included, retries once (`QUEUE_MAX_RETRIES`) from newer working state, never spent Resume grants, then `worker_crash_retry_exhausted`; a signal death reserves no delegated handoff and ends that attempt's running delegated runs. After process custody, startup recovers addressed `pending_drives`, nonterminal/synthesis obligations and saved answers before orphan healing.

#### Conversation lane

Startup and auto-resume notices name still-paused places (legacy too) without changing them. Owner Main/room turns, wakes, Presence bodies and auto-resume run in `WORKERS` slots with `lane="conversation"` (`conversation_lane.py`) outside the cap, memory admission, project leases and `disable_exhausted_worker_pool`: routing admits them RUNNING, published first; my human's undetached turn a stop, Resume or its sleep returned leaves PENDING for a lane carrier (`resumes_on_lane`). The pool's one ready spare is the owner's, replenished at once; a closed repo-writer gate stops spawns, never a dispatch; spawn success is the only bound. `inline_carrier.py` runs the same body on a server thread, disclosed (`inline_executors` in `/api/health` and the vitals): `inline_call` for a live voice call; `inline_degraded`, with an owner notice, only on a physical fact (`refused_carrier_reason`; §12).

#### Maintenance and custody

`delegate_collection.BodyRuntime` observes held runs independently of their authors, checking recorded grants; §6 owns collection and nanny judgment. Speech/outage transport and pending-frame replay: `delegate_feed.py` docstring (outside the acting cap).

`server_maintenance.HOST_DUTIES` lists off-loop tick passes, flat as history/live sets grow (`tests/test_cost_contract.py` B7; §10.24). Each pass reads actionable state once: reconcile skips queue rows, batches the rest; preparation and held custody rows re-read only when stamps move (`task_store.owing_documents`, `delegate_custody_current.held_runs`); receipt refreshes and settled pauses rest until inputs change. `owner_pause_control` stops ended members' runs on owner Pause and observes late recovery-fence writers (boot indexes `tasks_owner_pause`). Domain claims and receipts arbitrate writer checks. `bind_body_lifespan` observes after store publication; readiness enables collection; reviewer markers enable first-ready native capture (§6 collection/recovery). `invalid_source` wakes on watched files/rows/release (`source_retention._unavailable_basis`); busy cost reads stay unknown. Reaping proves PID/birth/command/task/generation. Watchdogs record stalls and suggest Restart; they kill no thread.

Bulk jobs use ordinary and trash children (`python -m ouroboros.maintenance`: low priority, Panic/exit census); `job:<name>` governs dispatch; throws set `last_error`. Order: `maintenance.JOBS`. Recovery gaps keep task sources. Plan changes queue signatures; missed wakes replay at dispatch, boot rechecks indexed plans. Non-contended examinations rest, keeping seat debt. Retirement wakes on age eligibility, nonblocking publication or a removed source tree; compression on terminal writes, boot or an open pass; startup/repair discover missed bytes; nothing else wakes them. Queue recovery, drive settlement and runtime custody stay in the server (holds: §10.32); Storage Free (§3) is explicit. Absent usage owners rest with debt; money-only passes select newer dirty revisions, arrivals recheck absence.

Cooperative project checkpointing (`supervisor/events_coop_checkpoint.py`) runs on two quiescence triggers—a root settling without live descendants, or the last child settling under a terminal root (root-scope budget stops terminalize the root first)—revalidating quiescence under Q before bounded git mutation. Only host-minted project roots qualify (never owner-attached folders); credential-shaped files stay excluded and disclosed, with durable success/skip/error receipts.

#### Bridge intake and commands

Bridge intake keeps identity, transport and durable acceptance; failed handlers requeue only their unprocessed memory tail, never accepted rows. Room input goes to its sole live reader, a warm question wait included, queued/held work not; a Project room's other live roots get it as carried context. Main's reader: only my human's admitted turn (`_route_main_followup`). Tell and answers owe mail to living work until its saved read, never resuming it: the asker, then proven admitted successors under each admission lock; else named ingress at the saved publication address for the asker's earliest live late-input head or a fresh head. Panic has emergency ingress.

The bridge recognizes `/panic`, `/restart`, `/review`, `/evolve [on|off]`, `/bg [start|stop|status]` and `/status`; other text is ordinary routing. Telegram panels say the window's works (`said_works`; unread: unknown). External transports invoke them only with positive owner identity and a current transport-specific owner-chat binding; unknown refuses and registers nobody; Panic's binding: `PanicIngress`. Commands reuse runtime-mode, queue, cancellation and typed-result authority.

Confirmed money and owner pauses owe a System notice per episode, technical waits one per task naming the cause in the reader’s language; the recorded chat row settles that debt (`pause_notices.py`).


## 6. Agent Core

`loop.py` runs tasks, direct turns and wakes; admission, completion, satisfaction, verification, review and artifact finality stay separate facts, never converted into one another.

#### Task lifecycle

`OuroborosAgent` runs in workers: pooled tasks and the mind's foci (§5 Conversation lane). `agent_task_pipeline.py` freezes contract/context, runs the loop, stores results/artifacts and root post-work (`post_task_synthesis.py`, `post_task_checkpoint.py`), then publishes. Store rows govern lifecycle (`get_task_result`, `query_data`); result JSON is import/export. `task_result_schema.py` admits rows (§11); usage owns money/tokens. Crash: `failure.kind="runtime"`; lost capture unknown. `finalization_timing.py` times delivery and shares reducer child reads; final evidence reads fresh. `supervisor/cognitive_operations.py` excludes typed operations from idle inference; deadlines/budgets/cancellation stay.

`task_store` reads the stable terminal page plus uncertain rows; the gateway applies effective global top N. `task_status` derives stability per body write; `store_hot_facts` backfills legacy NULLs by CAS. GET keeps envelopes without writes.

The transcript is append-only for byte-prefix caching (§6 Prompt caching). `transcript_prefix.py` counts scoped breaks by origin (round facts, Health), stamps attempt rows, blocking no send; before preparation/pricing it retires signed reasoning from the first change, or all for system/tools changes or no baseline. `model_execution` separates requested/routed/provider-reported models of the last accepted ordinary solve; empty/forced/review/post-task replies cannot replace it. `loop_nudges.py` asks the successor once after tool use; real work or an accepted text/hash settles it (DESIGN §5; CLIENT_CONTRACT §6).

`loop_delivery.py` keeps exact `DeliveryCandidate` bytes through verification/review failures. `outcomes.py` separates execution/objective/review/artifacts/child-absorption/custody. Receipts/exact references prove effects; tool errors alone never degrade answers. Unevaluated objectives keep `residual_tool_errors_without_review`. `FINAL ANSWER:` always survives; only `task_contract.answer_protocol="final_answer_line"` prompts it. Armed/sticky selection rejects direct array-wrapped controls as malformed; ordinary JSON is unchanged. `completed` can be unaccepted. Reasons persist; owner wording projects on read (§3).

Answers carry `terminal_host_notice` (plan/orphan limits), owner's `terminal_custody_notice` (stop receipt apart): nonempty custody only. Notices keep answer bytes/verdict, revive no approval; child (all categories)/plan-evidence hash them, changes void dispositions. CLI labels, Presence omits host status (either form). Salvage (stop/reap): a bounded preview chosen task-wide, not a final answer; full `get_task_result`/stop receipts. The reader labels cancelled rows `[CANCELLED_BY]`, others `[OWNER_CONTROL] command=stop_now|wrap_up|unknown` by recorded policy.

Prose outside selection episodes finishes unless recovery is needed. Finish checks child/pre-delivery facts (unexamined result — a typed no-send examined nothing — failed check, running children/open runs), reviews, skills/handover, owner sources, material, services and admission (`completion_held`). Facts and shown nonblocking reviews leave prose fresh (`delivery_facts.py` keeps `displaced_answer`, silence); other debts need `finish_task(action=finish|stop, answer|answer_sha256)`. Conflicting live/restored batches hold; compaction withdraws unavailable selectors. Stop delivers selected unfinished work without waits, review, generation, descendant cancellation or approval; no evidence undoes it. Presence counts a send only on host-confirmed delivery.

Provider death salvages text but ends `failed`/`infra_failed` with `provider_unavailable` (or `resource_refusal_no_resend`) and an immediate not-completed owner notice. One forced model call runs only while a call can land; wait expiry and `loop_llm_call.provider_no_call_source` forbid another paid window. `terminal_provider_notice` quotes the provider beside the result, never advises blind replay. A fresh prefix replaces its passive snapshot with one current fact and an exact reader for the prior view. #### Safety and runtime mode

Tool dispatch uses the registered capability, the explicit task/resource contract and one prepared physical target. Explicit task resources and the actual Git target are host facts, distinct from any semantic judgment about the call; this is not an OS sandbox.

Runtime mode is effective Access and a self-modification ladder. Light refuses mutation of the Ouroboros repository and control plane (`LIGHT_MODE_BLOCKED`; skill payloads under their own root stay editable) while user deliverables outside them stay buildable; Light cognitive writes go through `update_identity`, `update_world`, `update_scratchpad` or `knowledge_write`. Advanced evolves the application layer and built-in tools, not the protected set owned by `runtime_mode_policy.py` (`SAFETY_CRITICAL_PATHS`, frozen contracts, release/managed invariants; one policy shared by the registry, git tools and gateway guards, refusing typed `CORE_PROTECTION_BLOCKED`). Pro may write that set, announced by `CORE_PATCH_NOTICE`; ordinary commits follow the review wave (both questions). Cyber authority derives from effective Access (`runtime_mode_policy.mode_has_unrestricted_agency`); a saved next-boot mode never rewrites a running task. In Cyber Pro, internal review and Safety findings are advice under BIBLE P0/P3: independent assessments and the decision to proceed stay distinct facts. Panic is the owner's act, by design rather than by a lock: no checker, helper or focus raises it on its own judgment; the loopback door stays open by design (a real Panic must not depend on a password).

Admission preserves argv (including empty values), resolved cwd and target. `shell_parse.py`/`tools/write_shape.py` report syntax/targets, not permission. `safety.py` checks complete retained owner directives (focus records only if they reproduce the frame exactly; absent directives use quoted user turns), the prepared target, and one copy of owner/organization rules and place notes. Minds and sessions get the same actor-effective rules. Coverage is `OUROBOROS_SAFETY_MODE` Full/Light/Off over each tool's `TOOL_POLICY` entry, else its `ToolEntry.safety_policy` (extension, MCP and unknown tools are checked, not relays or declared reads such as an MCP `readOnlyHint: true`): Light skips conditional checks, Off every Supervisor call; each waved-through check leaves a durable `safety_mode_skip` event. `full → light → off` is a decreasing coverage ladder, so outside Cyber Pro a downward step is owner-only (`POST /api/owner/safety-mode`). Each admitted process effect executes once; later settings or repository observations annotate the original result, never repeat or revert it: a revert proves no causation. `env_from_settings` selects current effective Settings once at process dispatch (`selection_settings`, §7); service authority, nested reuse and diagnostic masking stay; running processes keep their env.

##### Safety Supervisor outcomes

Results open with the typed outcome; SAFE passes silently. A flagged call (SUSPICIOUS or DANGEROUS, any tool) returns once before any effect as `SAFETY_RETURNED`, never released in its step; a changed call is read afresh, save host-declared words waiting after DANGEROUS, to that destination. A later step's identical call passes unread when SUSPICIOUS, or DANGEROUS where the mind decides (Cyber Pro, `repeat_after_dangerous`); elsewhere it waits for my human's answered card with the exact words and destination, or exact call (`release_after_dangerous`); under any policy their later message or card answer in the work earns one new reading. No verdict (no route answering after the Fallback walk, `safety_route_fallback`; an over-budget subject, never truncated; an unusable answer after a repair retry) keeps its branch's let-through or hold (`SAFETY_UNAVAILABLE`); words and MCP calls wait in all modes; Cyber makes a built-in tool's hold advice (`safety_advisory`); an unread let-through, no-backend fail-open too, trails `SAFETY_NOTE`. A failed second check keeps the first verdict. A flag's final reading may mark the act as one the owner would stop (`"owner": true`, `safety_records.parse_safety_response`); when the mind's identical re-issue passes over such a flag, `safety_records.tell_owner_over_flag` queues the Supervisor's own signed `safety_notice` row through the terminal outbox, one per work and destination (`delivery_id`), never in the tool result. None is a tool failure; the open Done card names one left standing. A 429 storm latches its route in-process; a deployment checker uses only its own routes. `SAFETY_VIOLATION` is retired.

Outside Cyber Pro, shell git reads anywhere but mutates only resolved targets outside the system repo/runtime data (`git_shell_policy.py`; `git init`/`git clone` resolve destinations). Acting `self_worktree` children stay read-only: patch capture needs an unmoved HEAD. VCS defaults to `root=active_workspace` or takes explicit `system_repo`. `vcs_read` calls `git_vcs_ops` for status/diff (configured filters, non-UTF-8 patch/stat bytes escaped with notice). It serves history (external diff/textconv/pagers off, bounded capture naming omissions/narrowing) and identity (sequential observations). Dispatch selects a worktree under root by `repository`. Policy uses root coordinates and `path` filters the worktree. Historical content respects protected artifacts. Protected names constrain system-target restores and Advanced reverts; Pro/Cyber Pro mechanical reverts need no new panel. Other project names are ordinary content; `preflight_review`, `commit_reviewed`/`vcs_commit_reviewed`, `vcs_rollback` and promotion stay system-repository lifecycles. PR helpers share root, mode, child, credential and reviewed-publication rules. Outside Cyber Pro, a task contract may declare `resource_policy.protected_artifacts[]` as execute-only black boxes (`protected_artifacts.py`): reads, copies, hashes, static inspection and trace/debug wrappers over those paths are refused.

Technical failure and commit permission are separate facts: producers keep a failure's origin beside the original status and findings; what each Access level then permits is the protocol's rule (DEVELOPMENT "Review & Commit Protocol"), and neither changes quorum.

`usage_store.py` owns `state/usage.sqlite`, a row per physical attempt over `store.py` ([Usage store](../USAGE_STORE.md)). `usage_ledger.py` is policy-free; `usage_accounting.py` owns price, holds, settlement, scopes and admission. `model_activity` (`llm_claudexor.py`): phase changes, operation/invocation IDs, admission blockers. `loop_llm_call.py` binds `main_llm_call_state`; `supervisor.events` checks attempt/execution/round/call in pooled/direct activity. `context_attempt` carries ledger `physical_context` past the call: first-send time, newest attempt not proven unsent; `physical_attempt_context.fold_attempt` applies releases/late outcomes to their own identities. No quota wait or lease changes. `vision_process.py` deduplicates strict `_RECEIPT` identifiers (§3).

##### The live turn slot

Caller-owned `llm_claudexor.ModelTurnState` carries the opaque live-turn token through `LLMClient.chat`, outside history; neither compaction nor failed bodies rebuild it from old assistant envelopes. A dispatched durable result replaces it, released `invalid_continuation` repair clears it, other outcomes keep it. One `run_llm_loop` invocation spans rounds, steering, review and quota waits; the next loop/cold restart starts empty, leaving this transport ends it. Opt-in needs the last successful handshake at `config.CLAUDEXOR_MODEL_TURN_STATE_MIN_VERSION`. The token grants no generation and enters no usage/event/progress/task-card content.

##### Roles, accounts and context

`OUROBOROS_MODEL_ACCOUNTS`/`OUROBOROS_MODEL_CONTEXT_WINDOWS` bind roles (§7); equal model names imply no shared role/account. Route keys read the saved document live (§7), with `skill_settings` semantics: no mirrored stale key, an unreadable document leaves credentials unavailable. Reviewers/actors use route credentials. Auto uses the account's largest advertised window, never CLI compaction thresholds. Manual windows assert sizing, not provider/review authority; capacity/input/output reserve and unknowns stay distinct. Usage pairs submitted options/provider echoes; missing keys stay unknown. Account changes reprepare; ordinary/wrap-up/forced-final sends share role/account; headers name the responder. Review `default_temperature` is a route hint; explicit `temperature` (zero too) may fail. Quota/interruption/unknown custody are no result/verdict. `preferredProfileId` is soft: engine marks outrank it.

##### Configured routes and primary return

`model_slots.route_binding` names model/locality/account or Auto. Route choices and handover: `route_choice.py`, `loop_routes.py`. The primary (`route_choice.initial_round_route`) survives failed fallback: rows say trying (`model_lane_attempt`); plain progress reports adoption or last attempt. `primary_route_observation.py` renders `[ROUTE FACTS]` once per switch, never rewritten, naming the primary's chooser; changed, dated, non-generating metadata (Claudexor quota too) shares one 3 s budget. Cognition chooses stay, `switch_model(primary="return")` (the CURRENT primary; act logged apart from outcome) or `primary="wait"`. A return resumes `held_primary_view`. After ordinary 429/503 retries `loop_transport` waits on primary; only an answer ends waiting, metadata/clocks/resets prove no generation (P5/P13). Direct API auth/billing waits offer Retry/Switch/Stop, no subscription observer.

`lead_fact.py` publishes `work_lead` (CLIENT_CONTRACT §5). `owner_model.py`/`loop_routes.py` apply durable owner primaries before dispatch (PERSISTENCE).

##### Quota and auth waits

`execution_timeout_sec` / CLI `--execution-timeout` narrows the global ceiling via `model_wait.execution_elapsed_seconds`: queue, confirmed quota, Pause and sleep through Resume consumption are excluded once; tools/result waits count. No time is regranted; `timeout_sec` stays a calendar deadline.

`llm_capability_policy.model_catalog` negotiates `includeAdmission`; `catalog_admits_model` shares exact-model admission across waits and upstream recovery. Advisory absence permits an attempt without inventing a row; older engines keep membership semantics. Source/account/fingerprint/freshness checks stay; failed discovery is not empty success; admission proves neither generation nor the previous outcome.

`model_wait.py` holds the live call for quota/auth, dated pools or a gone connection via mailbox and `/api/decisions` `model_wait:<task>:<wait>`. Dated non-mixed pools are `unavailable`, undated refusals use transport recovery, only `poolCause` proves exhaustion. The engine alone places/deprioritises accounts; pins never rotate. Rows project admission and observed access, not a ledger. Another model's completed answer is retained/ACKed but rejected as the round; `model_substituted` means root fallback or exact-route-child failure, never requested-model cooldown (redo: rails). Resource refusals, a gone connection too (`ConnectionUnavailable`, $0; card `connection_unavailable`, never a failure alone), try configured routes (§7) before owner wait on the retained refusal, naming needed sign-in. Presence turns never wait (§12). Temporary switches affect only this wait; Settings, review and task application stay separate; Fallback Local is group-wide.

`gateway/task_model_wait.py` owns effects; `task_decision.answer_decision` serves Web/Host Service. `supervisor/task_model_wait.py` projects worker events/clocks; `gateway/decision_contracts.py` owns decision vocabulary. Worker/project-write ownership stays held (one worker means the queue waits); reviewers keep their operation through settlement (§6 Review stack). Browser closure keeps the wait; process stop ends that guarantee. Lost tracked VLM results (`vision_process.py`) stay unknown, never free. Review-operation decisions reach only the exact live `review_operation_controller`, never an ended author's mailbox. Consciousness (`handle_wake_direct`) shares owner-turn registration, model wait, Stop and unknown-outcome recovery.

##### Streams and transport waits

Main remote streams assemble in `llm_stream.py` before settlement; complete streams normalize like JSON. Partial answers/calls never execute; exact wire/assembly stay in private CAS (`physical_stream`, attempt id). Chat name deltas suppress an identical fragment, append others and disclose both (`a,a` becomes `a`); other deltas stay intact. Receipts name anomalies; terminal framing precedes shape validation. Complete unusable bodies are `stream_rejected` with received usage; unterminated streams have unknown outcomes. Typed timeout after output grants configured API children one same-actor physical repeat (`llm_attempt`): no repair, reroute or summary. `working_checkpoint` saves grant/dispatch/failure; warm and cold recovery cannot renew it. Unconfirmed dispatch is UNKNOWN. Retained `trace_refs.timeout_repeat` and call sources hand the parent the decision after GC. Native `timeout_error` qualifies; managed errors without typed progress do not. Missing final usage means unknown money. Pings set no cognitive deadline; HTTP bounds and logical waits differ.

`loop_transport.py` keeps one recovery episode (rails above). Mail can shorten backoff; `place_arrival.wake=false` cannot. Fresh non-generating upstream evidence may admit continuation with `[SYSTEM NOTICE]`: connectivity, not the old outcome or future success. Subscription catalog evidence requires `provenance="provider_http"`, `observedAt` after failure and matching source/model/account; cache reads never refresh it. Control-link/create/status/result-read failures (generic 404 too) rejoin the same operation or create key across endpoint rediscovery, proving no non-dispatch and generating nothing while recoverable.

#### Delegated subagents (Claudexor transport + the nanny)

Delegation adds no engine review panel. The start's `engine_version` is the handshaken serving version. Engine review, execution, parent integration and Ouroboros gates remain separate facts.

##### Child coordination, registry and scheduling

Tasks coordinate via `tree_note`/`tree_read`; a parent releases a child's constraint, a root its own. Read-only and acting children hold descendant-scoped `forward_to_worker`, `peek_task`, `cancel_task`, `discard_child_result`. Recursion widens no filesystem, budget, depth, deadline, commit or owner authority. Task mail also reaches same-tree peers as context-only `peer_task`: shared root is not ancestry (`owner_mailbox.py`). `delegation_budget` governs descendants; persisted admission outranks Settings; reduced depth reports `capability_reduced`, never a silent flat tree.

**Registry.** `configured_subagents.py` owns strict `OUROBOROS_SUBAGENTS {enabled, items}`, bounded by `MAX_CONFIGURED_SUBAGENTS`: id/handle (§3), multilingual guidance, API/session route, effort, pin, access, enablement. Off keeps settings, removes catalog/alternative/reviewer eligibility. `subagent_disabled`, global `subagents_disabled` and live unavailability differ. Guidance never ranks/routes: exact selection starts or refuses, without substitution. `inspect_subagent`, Accounts, quotas, health and primary observations share passive `claudexor_observations`; no start/refresh/selection. `quota_block` alone is not admission (PASSIVE_QUOTA_READ).

**Scheduling.** `schedule_subagent`: blank roles stay empty (§3). `workspace_root` defaults to the parent's; acceptance claims never inherit; `access=inherit` keeps configured rights, `readonly|workspace_write` narrow them; `write_surface` owns mutation authority. `subagent_intent_fields` carries intent through admission/worker/snapshot; `choose_effort` resolves `effort` (`auto` = omitted) with level/request/source. `select_subagent_snapshot` freezes the enabled API child or session leaf. `main_context_authority` keeps briefs idempotent; late history uses `resolve_task_lineage.is_root_task`, not roles; shared/declared helpers keep briefs/review authority; blank-role/retry roots and exact result reads keep predecessor history.

**Cognition.** `supervisor` selects enabled API cognition (subscriptions included); session, disabled, credential-less or API-child rows refuse. Omission follows the parent's role, not a fallback serving it. `supervisor_route.py` freezes `parent_cognitive_route` schema 2 (model, effort, locality, source role, account or empty Auto, processing, `chosen_by`, optional row snapshot) through queue, worker, results and restart; a following parent's nanny inherits and follows its role (`follows_role`); an own route is `parent_switch`. `model_slots` assigns `subagent:<supervisor row>` or inherited `subagent:<leaf row>`; legacy bindings stay frozen; persistence cannot convert session rows. Receipts/cards show recorded provenance and billing (subscription by route, measured only from observed cost, else unknown) with no pricing lookup or JS inference; leaf billing proves no nanny cost.

**Selected first-input sources** (`context_input_selection.py`). Every helper starts with my human's words for the work (`owner_words.py`: the tree's rows by value, the room's read at start, a session's kept from its scheduling), the marks in force and the knowledge outline; `declared` adds assignment/evidence, full SYSTEM/BIBLE/owner rules, authority/tools, own observations and applicable DESIGN map; `shared` adds the heads of the notes that claim its room and of the notes their heads link, book maps, identity, life account (not nannies) and room page, never whole dialogue. Children's signed chronicle drafts need the integrating mind's acceptance. Selection changes no read boundary, model/effort or independence/first-position guarantee; tools/mail can broaden evidence.

**Selected inputs** (DELEGATED_ADMISSION §3b): files or commit diffs replace folderless lineage; omission/null/[] keeps it. Each reader binds independently. Thread scope stays.

**Engine inputs** (`delegate_documents.py`, `claudexor_uploads.py`; DELEGATED_ADMISSION §3a): ready/uncertain keys survive copies/Continue. Owed managed releases feed `runtime_retirement` under tree/Continue/Keep holds, without local files. Keep shares custody with release; late Keep reports uncertainty; open uploads cancel before settlement.

**Historical author inputs.** `context_input_selection.capture_historical_inputs` pins first usable input on response and latest on evaluation as immutable redacted JSON; equal views deduplicate, others stay in observability. Logical input, verified projection/gap, Presence event and admission are distinct, never rebuilt live. Ordinary helper carriage coalesces exact rows only at the pinned first system fragment, never a draft or printed stamps.

`review_evidence.historical_author_inputs` sits beside owner/terminal inputs; no criteria, ACK or paid identity changes. Native/session readers use exact sources; packet previews disclose omissions. Size/hash ignore placement. Sources reach canonical/execution stores before publication; anchor refs alone govern retention and survive recovery. Missing or changed evidence stays unavailable.

##### Child handoffs and task waits

**Child reads and waits.** `get_task_result`/settled `wait_task` default to full handoffs; `wait_tasks` to `_compact_child_projection` (semantic handoff, nullable cost §11.1). Until terminal, `cost_final=false`. Short answer/summary/evidence reread current facts, not immutable sources (cancellation, unknown interrupted effects, unread mail, effort); they reject authority/source selectors. Matching child-result/join-ledger `known_result_sha256[_by_task]` gives `result_unchanged`, else the handoff. `get_task_result(call_id, manifest_sha256)` serves authorized character ranges of verified redacted calls/dispatches, Presence-scoped; never raw payloads/drafts. Queued/parked children show `current_stop` (`work_stop.task_current_stop`; `resume_child_task` for parent/root). Unsettled `wait_task` lists open non-review `delegated_runs`; unavailable/racing facts prove no liveness. Sibling advice: parent facts, no bodies; read failure drops only advice. Both waits use `SETTLED_STATUSES`; `sleep_mode` delivers on wake; cancel intent stays `cancel_state: pending`. `wait_expired_with_live_children` reports IDs/window without advice. `_wait_window` reserves `NESTED_SETTLEMENT_MARGIN_SEC` so executor emission outlasts the inner wait.

**Exact selections** (`task_result_views.py`): `authority_fields` reads top-level fields or their index; `source_only` reads source metadata/ranges. Partial recipes aren't full authority. `authority_projection_sha256` detects drift, not continuation-envelope `authority_sha256` or result identity. `delegate_output.project_task_output_readers`: physical-publisher/digest readers first, `direct_read` rootless, without receipt mutation or D7; Wrap up leads with it to EOF for its receipt task's own runs, portable readers for others.

##### Delegated spend and token reads

**Delegated cash.** `delegate_custody_usage.disclosed_cost` validates `attemptExecution[].usageCost` before summary cash. Ledger, nanny and review continuations keep known subtotals and unpriced remainders separately from estimates. Replay keeps history. `authPreference: subscription` prevents invisible paid-key fallback:

| disclosure | ledger | finality |
|---|---|---|
| settled zero | `subscription_session`, `0.0` | final, proven free |
| settled charge | amount | final |
| estimated | amount | nonfinal, including estimated zero |
| partial | known cash; `cost_partial`, separate `cost_estimated`; no bound | nonfinal; exact subtotal stays confirmed |
| undisclosed | null, increments `unknown_unmetered` | nonfinal |

Undisclosed cash adds zero only to known totals. `TOTAL_BUDGET` cannot fence undisclosed spend: finality is lost, no bound or charge invented.

**Native input.** `_usage_response._normalized_input_token_usage` accepts exactly total/read/write, nonnegative integers or null. After accounting, `delegate_collection` appends `llm_usage`; reviewers observe runs, attach-only with recorded attribution. Read facts survive continuation/cancel failures, apart from chain totals/extraction. Filters keep `input_token_usage`. `run_id`/`usage_scope=run` mark sessions; model stays unknown, final model/account in `observed_attempt`. Replay dedupes; event loss never warrants repeat inference. Legacy/tokenless stay unknown; first-facts readers may hide later facts. `effort_evidence.session_prompt_cache_ttl_request` sends captured advertised `promptCacheTtl` tiers; Default/continuations omit it. Final-attempt TTL separates intent and observation.

##### Nanny, transport and custody

**Nannies.** `agent_session`: unlimited bounded nonrecursive leaves, host verification, distinct start invocations, no concurrency/quota team cap. Tasks own lineage/authority/deadline/money/review/cancellation/descendants. Root `requested_depth` narrows by `depth_remaining`. Targets/access opaque; login: `gateway/claudexor_accounts.py`. Engine-scoped leaves may not see owner sessions or courier to them.

**Transport.** `gateways/claudexor.py` owns descriptor/handshake/`CLAUDEXOR_MIN_VERSION`; `trust_env=False` excludes proxies. `ensure_owned_gateway` or the run-bound work engine (`execution_domain`) starts reviewed engine/Node pins, never PATH; START reuses its proving handshake. Review seats: `in_flight` until allowance ends, then `not_dispatched`, never waived. `gateways/claudexor_observation.py` uses body-free wait-many after its contract probe, fetching detail on attention before `seen`; else per-run `get_run`. Releases attach. Unconfirmed acceptance: no stop-time guarantee. `OUROBOROS_CLAUDEXOR_BIN` overrides binary; `OUROBOROS_CLAUDEXOR_ATTACH_HOME` attaches without spawn/operator-home fallback. Stops: §9.

**Durable custody.** `delegate_custody_current.py` reduces `custody_runs` in `state/current.sqlite`; forensic outbox imports once. Coherent indexed snapshots (`task_snapshot`/`payload_snapshot`) see STARTED replace request with run. `health_runs`: own/held/possibly-unread rows (all on failure). OWNED/FOREIGN/UNKNOWN: unreadable storage never proves absence. UUID/Idempotency-Key names intent, not content. `delegate_accepted.py` binds accepted work once via noncreating lookup (miss sends nothing). `delegate_pending.py` admits replay (orphan recovery below); a request ID proves no receiving store. Missing/corrupt sources stay unknown, no POST. Containment incidents persist.

`delegate_invocation.py` owns indexed first-request/last-start and operation/slot identity for all review/retry readers. Its docstring specifies import/rebuild and legacy proof: unknown custody never authorizes a replacement send (`test_review_invocation_current.py`).

`delegate_collection` keeps facts, output and money; input-bound retry rules: `delegate_capture_attempt.py` docstring. `delegate_capture_job` captures in the maintenance child before `dialogue_import`; its docstring owns revalidation by the lock holder.

`delegate_named_evidence` publishes immutable receipts; failed copies await its staging remover. `collect_terminal` owns publication/disposition; reviewers keep their owner/modes. Startup/Stop/Restart never join capture. Retention grants no EOF, ACK or verdict; billing and execution identities survive. Observation starts no daemon/POST and answers/applies nothing.

Finish cancels ordinary orphans (late discoveries survive); interruption requests bound-run cancel. Subtree Stop follows parents (`stop_tree_runs`). Without a verdict, crashes, transport/provider loss, unknown ownership and cold waits spare runs. Panels keep critics. One-shot roots register below the engine floor. Proven post-`START_REQUESTED` no-send retires fresh transient registrations, never shared/persistent/thread/recovery. Lost replies keep custody; exact lookups bind, misses prove nothing. Auto-replay needs admitting-store proof; accepted risk bars both replays. The starter lock orders choice and handoff outside I/O. `delegate_continuation.still_continuable` keeps rights or unknown authority. Cleanup retains causes and ledger debt. `started_uncustodied` needs absent/terminal proof.

**Cancel receipts.** `delegate_cancel`: `confirmed` (verified terminal/absence), `requested`, `failed` or `containment_fault_run_may_still_be_live`; failures keep a critical incident until closure. Only run-detail 404 naming admitting `context.storeId` (legacy unbound excepted) closes absence without inventing terminal/usage/spend. Recovered-run Stop needs exact run/store, not a status write. Proven unsent retries; ambiguous or acknowledged sends are read back. After ambiguity or proven sender exit, newer owner Stop reserves once after a fresh exact live read.

##### Nanny verbs and continuation

**Nanny verbs** (`tools/delegate.py`): start, wait, cancel, answer, message. Start takes `subagent_id` or recovery-only `retry_of`; saved supervision restores before admission; unobserved availability proves no readiness or capability loss. Messaging needs cataloged `POST /v2/runs/:id/messages` and `liveInput != none`; delivery proves consumption, not obedience; a live message steers its attempt; `capability_read_failed` stays unknown. `not_active`/`interaction_pending` carries a question artifact, never auto-answer. Definite refusal needs a typed cause, no handle and `definitely_unrun`/`_DEFINITE_UNRUN_REASONS`: UNRUN at $0; ambiguity wakes judgment. Zero-run excludes `review_owned`; accounting/containment/registration count all runs; nothing caps admission (DELEGATED_ADMISSION).

At receipt, `owner_relay` mails every live tree member and `delegate_interactions` places rows no START body held into non-review live-input runs as `owner_words` frames, independent of turns/capacity (§10.26). Root drain and starter round-top catch up; pending-frame replay belongs to `delegate_feed.py`.

**Addressed talk.** `delegate_shared.message_run` admits starters, ancestors and same-tree tasks; foreign roots/installs refuse; `_owned_run` control stays. `delegate_message_store.py` commits the host frame (sender id/role/row/model/time/relation) and wire bytes before POST; replay binds them. `delegate_progress` shows the journal in the starter's next receipt, no wake/ACK. `delegate_reply.py` carries `reply_to={starter_task_id, run_id, interaction_id OR plan_run_id, question_ids}` through questions, mail, escalation and owner answers: only the starter submits, stale/wrong refuse, absence selects nothing.

**Continuation** (`delegate_continuation.py`): `continue_from` starts new work/cap/key; work may repeat. Needs recorded lineage, observed terminal (money may lag), no prior continuation/ambiguous apply, inherited-or-narrower access, same writer target except plan implementation. Readonly replaces execution, revokes auxiliary writes, separates old patch (DELEGATED_ADMISSION §2). `continuity` names carrier; `packet` re-briefs. Cause, unread result, route/work-order changes enter `prompt`, not retained `instructions`; access/binding and new input map are restated. `retry_of` replays request/receipt; no recapture.

**Plan leaves** (`delegate_plan.py`) use `review_thread_continuity` and ordinary starts; admission needs engine plan support. Custody pins mode/access/thread/ceiling; artifacts keep refs; engine detail supplies questions/readiness, not live interactions. `delegate_answer` adds a turn; plan clarifies, only the starter implements (agent) within its current ceiling, with recorded `override_plan_readiness` for open/unverified questions. Host checks retained bytes; engine pins hash/plan file. Authorization precedes send, shows on the card, replays unchanged; legacy ceilings grant nothing. Git/payload stay private, folders implement in place; folder copies need a new executor. Ouroboros synthesizes N plans; engine council stays unwired.

**Execution evidence.** `delegate_evidence.task_execution_evidence` projects custody (§11.1). `delegate_start_attempted` counts blocked/uncustodied attempts: refusal is not ignored delegation. `applied_access_profiles` uses SETTLED rows only; an absent patch disposition is unrecorded, not "reviewed clean".

**Work orders** (`subagent_work_order.py`): assignment → `prompt`, normalized contract → `instructions`. `session_host_references` adds owner rules, body DESIGN/BIBLE, enabled skills (whole always-in-context; unless declared), writable Git environment/service paths and serving payload contracts (even when declared). `START_REQUESTED` pins bytes/ranges. Selection receipts grant no governance or access. Blocked checks return command/evidence to the integrator (DELEGATED_ADMISSION §2). Tool-less seats need excerpts; incomplete coverage bars PASS/apply (`delegate_source_coverage.py`).

**Supervision.** The nanny's `delegate_wait` sleeps via `run_wait` and yields acting capacity; the body observes independently (§5). It and `await_messages(runs=…)` refuse reviewer runs before sleep, naming the original collector, reader or gap. Replay separates response timestamp and requested TTL from waiting. `delegate_wait`: holds need positively live ordinary leaves. Checkpoint schema, migration and downgrade limits: PERSISTENCE.md; sibling-safe merges and corruption: `delegate_supervision_state.py` docstring. Legacy wake replay: `delegate_supervision.unseen_wake_view`.

`delegate_bootstrap_identity.py` persists leaf-first identity under the actor lock. Restart observes; explicit starts take fresh rows, omission keeps the assignment. Retry keeps row/body; empty-prompt replacement needs settlement. Evidence separates initial/later work. Zero-run, unreadable custody/billing, starter-only control and same-snapshot single-writer floors stay ([details](../DELEGATED_ADMISSION.md)).


##### Live room Subagents mode

`settings_integrity.live_subagents_mode()` reads the room at admission and each round (§7). Scheduler-stamped work (`schedule_writer_kind`), including Presence promises, reads Swarm as Auto and keeps Off; unscheduled autonomous work keeps its controls. Off hides catalogs and refuses new runs (`schedule_subagent`, `delegate_start`, `continue_from`, plan answers; `subagents_off_in_room`). Running helpers, Off→on and Settings: CLIENT_CONTRACT §9.

Receipts keep starts, `refused_starts`, reviews, models, cost and unfinished work. Only proven zero attempts/starts hides the line; gaps stay unknown (§3).

##### Dispatch, route health and history

**Configured dispatch is exact.** `subagent_runtime.resolve_configured_actor_dispatch` checks live availability for fresh work (saved supervision: Nanny verbs); bad choices return typed cause, alternatives, reset time and `host_fallback:false`, never ranking, first-healthy selection or session→API conversion. The parent LLM chooses `agent_session`: the host sets truth, money and authorship floors; the model owns topology, decomposition and supervision (BIBLE P13/P5). History grants no admission: fallback success cannot certify failed routes; code/test failures cannot condemn providers.

Wakes never block journal append; missed wakes await publication/repair. Replay replaces producers; inspection reads facts.
