Overlap is not productivity; missing causal edges stay unknown (never summed lifetimes); live actors, including unresolved starts, keep receipts provisional; accepted `finish_task.swarm_comparison` is mind-attributed; no thresholds or automatic choice.

##### Run shape and mutation authority

**Run shape.** `subagents.delegated_run_shape` serves starts, dispatch and review seats. Optional `mode=ask|plan|agent` on `delegate_start` and configured-session `schedule_subagent` lowers ask/plan to readonly. API children keep ordinary execution; explicit mode refuses.

| task authority | access | mode | isolation | `execution.delegated` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| acting subagent (valid write surface); ordinary root with a validated external workspace or selected Project room; top-level task selecting an exact skill payload (`root="skill_payload"`); research or reviewer seat without write authority (investigation) | captured `full` or `workspace_write` | `agent` | `live` | `true` |
| explicit `readonly`, Observe research, a Presence ceiling without delegated write, a fail-closed subagent | `readonly` | `ask` | envelope | omitted; false on writable→readonly continuation |

Host-derived **mutation authority** (`tools/delegate_integration._mutation_authority` / `_payload_mutation_authority`) separately names the destination; never model-supplied:

| source | `target_root` derivation | `capture_mode` |
|---|---|---|
| `acting_constraint` | the child's own `task_constraint.write_root`, required to equal the active workspace root | `delegated_snapshot` or `in_place` |
| `external_workspace_root` | the root task's validated external workspace or selected Project room | `delegated_snapshot` or `in_place` |
| `skill_payload` | the exact payload the fresh `skill_payload.write` binding resolved | `delegated_snapshot` |
| `readonly` | ordinary active root (nothing to write) | `none` |
| `investigation` | the active root, as provenance only | `evidence` |

`subagent_worktrees.provision_payload_snapshot` gives Git-free payloads independent private Git snapshots; undisposed captures never cap starts. `integrate_payload_patch` locks target CAS/apply/publication. Whole-payload drift conflicts; equality is idempotent; `blocked_reserved_paths` refuses all; baseline-equal `apply_no_op` proves no write, other hashes keep ambiguity. Success calls `request_extension_reconcile` and stales review; mode-only changes refuse `unreviewable_metadata_change`.

##### Snapshots, capture and disposition

**Snapshots.** Native/API `external_workspace` reverse-checks only its captured shared Git delta, never whole work or authorship, under current read/Presence/task rights; no tree/index writes, mismatches await `accept`/reject. Index-held entries/links keep Git semantics; denied-hash/unstageable/unexaminable paths stay unknown. `subagent_worktrees.snapshot_commit` links writer/investigation/task copies of index/files. Ignored files stay out; nested repos/populated submodules/unreadable folders retain writer checkouts. Integration needs current write/Presence rights; body protected paths obey dispatch's rule; refusals name mode or grant. Seats/body candidates link frozen trees, candidates on branches. Pinned result C from B: saved → release checkout; empty → `no_changes`; continuation → restore; gone unsaved → `execution_snapshot_missing`; unreadable custody retains. `workspace: in_place` uses the starter's root; `delegate_directory` stages folderless inputs. `scope.root` grants reads; `execution.workspaceRoot` binds writes (scratch/evidence: DELEGATED_ADMISSION).

Capture (`capture_terminal_patch_for_drive`) needs execution end, not money. Git readiness needs a receipt. Prove older bytes in scratch; never overwrite saved bytes. Show changes and moved HEAD before apply. Native disposition lends custody to evidence publication. GC retires copies; unwritten rows or unretained evidence hold them. Eligible empty Git: `no_changes`. Git checks baselines, stages, never commits. Git-only `target_files_changed` survives receipt or refresh failure. Proof allows receipt-only retry (`_admit_git_apply`); else acknowledge ambiguity after inspection.

Payload and seat capture share `subagent_worktrees.stage_raw_payload_inventory`/`_RawBlobWriter`: filter-free `fast-import`, then index path/mode/blob checks.

**Terminal products.** Revisions keep metadata/reader/hash across output retries; previews earn no EOF. Investigations self-dispose (`evidence_retained`) only after full output/required sources survive, never as acceptance. `undisposed_patches` keeps run/target until `PATCH_DISPOSED` names `disposed_by_task_id`. Only `result_loss` proof (no copy, usable capture, pin, Git-held work; own pin restored first) lets reject mark `result_lost`, keeping what a failed capture saved; a predecessor's pin keeps an uncaptured continuation owed. Confirmed automatic retries may read/dispose terminal-observed products, not live control; shared roots, manual Continue, review-owned runs, `CLOSED_ABSENT` grant none. Takeover supersedes predecessor; cumulative work applies once. Orphans need proven owner terminality. Off the active folder, apply targets the recorded path inside configured projects/worktrees roots (any creator) under `copy_apply_refusal`'s current rights; no rebind/grant. Own/retry targets stay exact; reject needs no write. Missing/unreadable/unreaped ownership keeps custody. Late sources transactionally re-owe a closing receipt with canonical source/digest (`delegate_terminal`/`context_health`).

**Custody disclosures heal from the write side.** Unreconciled own runs are debt beside the cause: `delegated_runs_unreconciled` and its envelope warn while non-empty (`outcomes.objective_warned`); readers never replay custody, `delegate_terminal.py` audit writers refresh it, unknown clears nothing. Old `delegated_custody_unreconciled` stamps stay, read beneath (`recorded_cause`), warning until the list is known empty. Frozen `delegated_runs_*` counters stay; `actual_substrate` follows live custody; clean debt is no evolution failure.

Disclosed isolation residuals: a non-owner orphan's verdict stays with its disposer. Task-drive Git locks let nanny integrations interleave in one external tree; drift makes the losing apply a typed conflict. Copies share their source's refs, stash and hooks; in-place writers skip the delegated protected-path gate and can mix.

**Native product succession.** `integrate_subagent_patch` admits finished native direct-child products (cancelled: ready capture) via hash-verified `owner_continue.continuation_chain`, with target/CAS/resource checks. Exact-result decisions stand; observations retry. Successor verdicts/marks keep original parent/child/hash; lineage, evaluation, controls, cancellation and missing marks stay unchanged.

##### Access disclosure

**Native access disclosure.** Full access has no filesystem sandbox; snapshots own delivery (an `in_place` writer delivers as it edits). `CLAUDEXOR_DELEGATED_MARKER_MIN_VERSION` is a schema floor: `route_health` blocks incompatible mutating requests before spend; read-only delegation omits the marker. Attempt evidence alone determines isolation. Missing containment discloses `delegate_run_unconfined` without refusal: the child already has native shell access. Recorded `harness_home_isolated:false` or claimed isolated HOME equal to the operator's cancels as a breach; nested HOME is disclosed-unconfined; missing HOME evidence stays unproven. Applied-evidence readers, threat model/floors: DELEGATED_ADMISSION.

**Authority.** Start accepts session `subagent_id`, prompt, duration, lowering-only access, mode, `workspace` copy/in_place, retry/continuation, payload/document selectors (DELEGATED_ADMISSION §3a); no isolation/scope override. Retry replays recorded rights and host instructions. Native access grants no task/edit authority. `_containment_breach` checks engine-applied access/HOME: wider cancels (`access_profile_widened`), narrower passes.

#### Vendor program maintenance

`harness_maintenance.py` serves Accounts/Connect; `ouroboros/gateways/claudexor_maintenance.py` owns the 6.0.0 floor; `ouroboros/tools/control_maintenance.py` owns mind tools. Authority/Pause apply; no automatic update, version ordering or job ledger. Connect joins active installs under one deadline, returns definite refusals, cancels nothing and retries login once after selected-version evidence. Unknown POSTs keep key/body/context.

`harness_program_facts.py` saves `state/harness_programs.json`. Claims spend each generation/settlement once, even on failure; locks cover only file work. Newer rows win; the latest full answer governs membership. Context reads only the file: dated installed/newest facts, unavailable checks and incomplete coverage, or “not observed”. No timer; lifetime: PERSISTENCE.

#### Own-body candidates

Body authors (queued roots, owner turns, evolution cycles) write a task-owned linked worktree, never the serving checkout, so unfinished edits stay out of serving imports. It starts at the serving HEAD on `candidate/<task>` under the isolated worktree root; its `kind=body_candidate` copy record restores the binding across a retry, Resume or new worker. `prepare_self_change` prepares it; body writes, PR-integration verbs (`git_pr.BODY_WORKTREE_TOOLS`) and an acting `self_worktree` child reach it through `body_candidate.authoring_seam` before resolving a target; earlier reads stay on the serving tree. Light mode, capped trees, subagents and the managed-update resolver get none; Cyber Pro may choose `in_place`; a body with no Git tree keeps in-place authoring. First binds and explicit receipts list open neighbours' changed paths.

Binding names the candidate in `repo_dir`, `system_repo_dir` and `branch_dev`; body edits and `commit_reviewed` share that identity. An explicit workspace or room folder stays the planning base (Plan construction below); the candidate is no external workspace. `serving_repo_dir` supplies governance, restart markers and rollback. Processes in candidates or admitted body-child copies use `<candidate>.env` (`test_environment.isolated_environment`): private HOME/data, no credentials or global Git config, pip in a venv. Push/provider calls need another cwd. Failed preparation refuses `CANDIDATE_ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE`, never borrowing the serving one.

The root owns the candidate. A validated continuation or exact `prepare_self_change(resume=…)` transfers it only from a terminal owner with settled ledgered processes, never by room/name/date. Attribution uses its clean original, the prior owner's established basis or genuine creation `base_sha`, not today's files. Proven late capture is superseded with history intact; other observations keep uncertain dirt. `commit_reviewed` retries missing attachment, applies the selection rules below; no auto-push. Commits are neutral (carriers unchanged, no tag), numbered (all synced, tagged) or a development marker (all but links and history, no tag), never a partial bump. Retention dates last use: a copy without unique work may expire; unique work is pinned on `refs/ouroboros/candidates/<id>` before removal under `body_candidate.verdict_holds`. A nested `OUROBOROS_RETAINED.txt` keeps checkout and environment.

Adoption is deliberate and restart-bound (`body_adoption.py`): `request_restart(adopt_commit=<sha>)` (its reason is the caller's claim), or an evolution cycle's own restart, authorizes one exact reviewed commit on the serving HEAD (guards: `authorize_row`; Cyber Pro records a gate exception); a constitutional change needs a numbered release outside Cyber Pro. The old generation never writes the tree (re-verification and arming: the module docstring), and the candidate file's engine pin decides the owned daemon first (§9). The owner's Restart and Panic never arm or wait (no stuck stop holds the owner hostage). The switch and recovery are §2; `settle_on_boot` records `adopted` only for a bootstrapped, supervisor-ready generation that attested the switched tree before its imports; each outcome is its authorizing task's (`body_adoptions`, card row, `official_relation`); the row names as running its commits landed over a review FAIL or no verdict (`review_overrides.py`).

#### Git and commit review

`pr_merge(number, expected_head_sha, method)` sends one synchronous REST merge of that head as the selected gh identity to the PR read back. `merge_receipts.py` writes intent before effect, reviewed/current/merged apart; `review_record_id` covers via `base..head`, or index/worktree via a `commit_landings` row of the exact merged SHA; declarations never prove PASS. `checks`: runs, failures, omissions. Merge/squash messages carry `update_qualification` receipts. Missing checks: unknown; reviews never veto. Unknown/queued readbacks only observe; `NO_EFFECT`, a merged readback or Resume naming a settled unknown frees custody; `continue_receipt_id` decides one new request; links survive trimming. Shell/web merges lack receipts.

`github_read` pages with disclosed cuts and GET/query-only api; gh runs read-bound (read-only children too); a read naming `repo` needs no checkout but for `{branch}`; logs/artifacts keep bytes/size/sha256, unextracted. `github_write` returns actor/readback receipts, looking up unanswered sends without resending. PR methods need expect.head_sha (base_sha to create/retarget): `create_pr`; `update(kind="pr",target=N)` edits title/body/base by one REST PATCH at the read PR's URL (no read:org) or toggles draft separately. Nonatomic precheck → one send → readback; failed/lost sends stay unknown, never resent, but a PATCH 4xx with all sent fields read back unchanged is not applied. Hub shares `github_pr_identity.py`.

`mutation_attribution.py` records root-task baselines of admitted folders (`capture_root_baseline`) and adopted predecessor changes. A stale/ambiguous baseline blocks automatic staging for review to weigh; in a candidate an explicit selection may name uncertain paths or pass an overlapping moved base (never re-anchored), its facts reaching brief, handback and next epoch. `commit_reviewed` stages only attributed paths (explicit: a subset; empty: `GIT_NO_ATTRIBUTED_CHANGES`; omitted in a continuation: its reviewed ones); managed updates keep whole-tree authority. Terminal dirty-only counts (a candidate's uncertain dirt included, as `attribution_uncertain`) ride execution facts to live/history cards; paths and HEAD stay in Details. Failed scans are unknown, clean retained commits silent; outcomes and adoption stay separate.

Commit, tag, post-commit tests and push each pass `owner_pause.run_operation`: Pause after review refuses an unsubmitted commit; an ordinary one handed off stays a success whose later steps report not started; after Resume they are the author's explicit work, never a new commit. A managed merge keeps `postcommit_resume`; `commit_reviewed` rechecks HEAD and clean tree, finishes tests and smoke, lands on the receipt's review (older: none), no new commit or rollback (`git_managed_postcommit.py`).

Commit preparation preserves native merge state: no checkout of the current branch, no switch during a pending merge or failed state read; path-only unstaging keeps `MERGE_HEAD/MODE/MSG`. One staged fingerprint binds tree, ordered parents, VERSION, expected/existing tag and binary diff, rechecked after commit before success or push; release tags are never silently accepted or retargeted. Seats inspect that snapshot; mutation stales its binding. The early look changes neither tests nor binding. Managed resolution reviews M0→S (`tools/review_subject.py`) while binding S to the index tree. `release_sync.sync_release_metadata` projects carriers; `VERSION_CARRIER_SPANS` / `substitute_carrier_spans` serve both resolver and packet cut. BIBLE owns authority, CHECKLISTS criteria, DEVELOPMENT procedure. GitHub child commands append existing `platform_layer.common_tool_directories` after inherited PATH entries; process bootstrap shares that list but keeps its once-only prepend policy.

Every outcome returns whole with `review_reference` before Git; `shown_outcomes` names what was rendered, and a later one refuses continuation until collected free (Cyber Pro states the gap). Own or recorded-Continue continuation with caller's `author_disposition` binds the current candidate, states its difference from the reviewed tree, reruns preflight, tests and Git checks, dispatches no critic; handback is `reviewed/review_only`, pending `reviewing/late_wait`; evicted free rows read their settled record. Evolution receipts keep actual `triad_scope_status`, never an inferred PASS.

##### Commit review evidence

`review_evidence.capture_commit_review_evidence` freezes the selected browser and vision calls and same-round image attachments, unavailable-image gaps included, once per attempt (after free admission, before the look and the wave) as one canonical task source handle: native reviewers read its ranges under the canonical root, sessions receive byte-identical bytes in an ignored `.review-drive/<task>/<sha>.txt`, packet-only reviewers a bounded, disclosed partial view. The trace keeps exact redacted arguments and the next visible response of the same execution; adjacency never attests visual inspection. A pending rejoin restores the same source from the frozen request; cleanup waits for physical custody.

##### Hermetic preflight proof

Only `preflight_runner.py` mints `ctx._preflight_test_proof` after green lanes/containment, binding HEAD/tree/index, pass specs, isolated env, Python and Node. `test_selection.py` selects the commit's tests; release-only text normalizes EOLs. `preflight_inventory.py` reconciles executed IDs; a lane start needs an acquired process (else not started/unknown). Tiers, records and forced runs: DEVELOPMENT "The tiered commit and CI gates".

`preflight_qualification.py` consumes exact-commit evidence for adoption/evolution publication. Complete runs (all lanes, two workers or the one admitted) write unsigned cross-process `state/preflight_receipts/<key>.json`; selected records need an exact commit (schema 2, never full). Identity binds Git, Python metadata and loaded source, not evidence paths. Forgery, other executables and unrecorded package edits are outside its trust. Seats receive frozen `preflight_execution`, whose `status` alone claims proof (`observed`: other runs, whole redacted diagnoses, checks).

##### Commit preflight

`preflight_review(deterministic_only=True, source="worktree" | "index")` returns free diagnostics before sync, staging, review-state access, provider checks, tests or fingerprints. `commit_admission.release_metadata_diagnostics` checks VERSION, carriers and P9. Managed integration keeps the official version; index diagnostics and review-only cycles admit contributions. Reports give source, status (`clean`, `blocked`, `unavailable`, `not_applicable`) and findings, no freshness/history write. `book_balance` labels worktree bytes (`reference_books.py`); growth never blocks locally. Syntax and critic review are separate.

The author's preflight is one look: `commit_reviewed(preflight_reviewer="<row>")` names one enabled catalog row by id or handle, pool member or not; after the free checks and tests the gate runs `review_change(subject=worktree, surface=preflight, reviewers=[row])` on the system repository before the wave (`commit_gate.run_commit_preflight`). The look informs and never gates: its record's reuse key carries `surface=preflight`, so it never answers the commit panel; the commit record's `preflight` fact names it (`performed` with record, row and aggregate; `not_performed` without the argument, never an audited bypass; `skipped` under `skip_advisory_review=True`). The look counts against `review_change`'s paid-cycle cap and holds no commit custody. `preflight_review(reviewer=…)` (`tools/preflight_review.py`, `advisory_review` alias) is the same look standalone, without tests or release-metadata sync.

The free checks (`commit_gate.deterministic_preflight`) run on every commit, even a skip: size headroom, diff pulse and worktree readiness as information and warnings, then the staged index's release metadata and staged `.py` syntax. Only release and syntax findings block; readiness lines go to the owner's progress and the events log. The diff pulse (`review.diff_pulse`: size, suite and code-shape facts since `reference_books.contribution_base`, the books' balance and one question; no threshold; its docstring lists each fact) ends every system-repository edit result and heads each non-managed body subject's brief. Tests run unless `skip_tests` (documentation has tests too), always for a managed resolution. The reviewed-commit cycle (`git_review_cycle`) checks authorization and unresolved prior work before staging, binds the exact candidate before free-cycle and budget admission, and revalidates the index and worktree snapshot before the wave. No surface projects a `repo_commit_ready` verdict.

#### Review stack

`review_cycles.py` owns the shared review-cycle ceiling `OUROBOROS_REVIEW_MAX_CYCLES` (a positive integer or `unlimited`; anything else fails closed to the shipped default; §7). One number, three gate meanings per root task (plans stand outside it): paid result waves (attempt rows under `review_result`), independently of the mind's responses, and free rewording reminders; paid commit-gate review waves, counted from the attempt ledger at dispatch, so the ceiling counts money; paid skill waves (in the manual lane, per content version). Byte-identical material replays each gate's recorded verdict for free; what consumes capacity is DEVELOPMENT §5's. The last allowed wave still permits an author reaction; a task contract's `budget_profile.max_improvement_passes` is accepted and read by nothing; `unlimited` removes only the count, not the ordinary task rails (§10 invariant 17).

Review waiting has six independent axes:

| axis | bound |
|---|---|
| transport | dead-socket read bound |
| operation | typed active-operation lease |
| logical | slot/task deadline |
| policy | budget / cancellation |
| absolute | task ceiling |
| aftermath | late-result custody |

##### Physical custody

`review_custody` owns workers and operation identities under every waiting axis. `review_wave` shares the first detach across drains; consumed mail strands no sibling. Permits belong to physical workers until durable settlement, never drains or free rejoins. Pause fences unsent starts even after Resume, wait-only exits never (`review_pause.left_wait_only` for drain and start checkpoint). Outer failures persist before readiness. Progress says "answer received, verdict being read" before parsing; only parsed answers say "answered". Each seat publishes its execution at settlement.

Capture state proves custody: `dispatched|unresolved` without terminal HTTP status is custody-lost/no-resend. Only explicit `__cause__` or typed metadata proves pre-dispatch. Returned answers and terminal errors settle even when empty; socket death stays `provider_outcome_unknown`, never another paid route. Transport defaults do not limit reasoning; windows narrow to the owner deadline minus finalization reserve. A spent window refuses at $0; commits have no outer cutoff. `review_live_join` keeps the original remaining window and Pause/Stop controls; cold collection stays nonblocking.

##### Paid stamp and owner custody

The `paid` fact behind the ceiling is recorded write-ahead at physical dispatch (`review_dispatch.py`: one once-only `ReviewPaidStamp` per wave, stamped at each delivery's own boundary: a packet row, a native episode's paid send, a session's replayable `START_REQUESTED` row); assembly, pre-send refusals, replays and rejoins skip that seam, so a $0 attempt stays outside every ceiling; neither a worker outliving its caller nor a crash after dispatch loses the fact. The stamp is idempotent across the wave's concurrent deliveries, so each seat waits for the write's result before its transport; commit review and `review_change` (result and skill waves included) treat a failed write as fail-closed; other callers keep fail-open accounting.

Before the wave, one locked write records the reserved roster and operation ids in the attempt row, bound to its server session and pid (`review_owner_custody.py`); the first send's stamp adds `paid=True`. A delegated seat patches `pending_invocation_id` before the provider POST; a missing or mismatched operation on resume is `custody_lost` on every install. Owner loss is proven by pid death, never by elapsed time: a TTL would turn waiting into resend authority.

Delivery is a catalog-row property read by `reviewer_slot_config.review_pool_slots` (§7 Review pool). The one shared session target is `OUROBOROS_REVIEW_SESSION_ROUTE` (`review_execution.REVIEW_SESSION_ROUTE_ENV`), an opaque `harness[=model][:effort]` spec falling back to `OUROBOROS_SUBAGENT_HARNESS` when unset, so one delegated route is configured once; a set but unparseable value turns review sessions off with a warning, never silently re-routing them.

##### Surfaces and money admission

The review surfaces:

- Change review (`tools/review.py`) — the pool's seats cover the layered Change Review Checklist (the Ouroboros Body Layer joins the universal core on the body; `review_helpers.load_checklist_layers`) with JSON findings under `config.adaptive_quorum`. A packet seat answers contract A (`triad_review.REVIEW_JSON_ARRAY_CONTRACT`, the findings array); a retrieving seat answers contract B (`REVIEW_TWO_PART_OBJECT_CONTRACT`: `{change, change_clean, coupling}`): one wave, two questions, one quorum over ASSIGNED seats (`review_ledger.reduce_verdict`, also used by `ParsedTriadReview.quorum_met`).
- The coupling question (`tools/review_brief_coupling.py`, Part 2 of the retrieving seat's brief) — intent, scope and coupling across the whole repository, asked of every retrieving seat of the same wave; there is no separate scope role (§6 The coupling question).
- Parallel orchestration (`tools/parallel_review.py`): fit and build every brief before dispatch; any deterministic assembly block costs $0. `tools/review_admission.py` discloses estimates by actual send and gates known spend at global `TOTAL_BUDGET`, root and group (`review_wave_budget_gate(surface="commit_gate")`). A refused wave records `$0 not_dispatched` per seat and one `review_wave_budget_insufficient` with `binding_axis`. This is a passive precheck; per-seat reservations enforce mid-wave fences. Admission exceptions fail open and log `review_wave_admission_unavailable`. Session seats ride the owner's subscription; the gate neither prices nor awaits them.

A free refusal never wears a verdict's form: a $0 exit is a typed `not_dispatched` fact with its reason, never a DEGRADED panel or a synthetic actor; a request never sent is one seat with `operation_state='not_dispatched'` that stays in the denominator. Part 1 catches line errors; Part 2 catches cross-module contracts, from the same seat over the same staged snapshot (managed updates: M0→S), so one answer cannot hide the other. A result wave (§6) and a skill wave (§13) share quorum and transports and ask one question each; the result record binds to the task's delivered answer, the skill record projects into the skill's run gate.

One pool, many subjects — who calls the wave and what each seat is asked:

| subject | caller | questions |
|---|---|---|
| the body's staged index (a commit) | `commit_reviewed` — the gate | pool seats named with a reason when narrowed; Cyber Pro composes; change part, coupling part on retrieving seats |
| the body's live worktree before a commit | `commit_reviewed(preflight_reviewer=…)` / `preflight_review(reviewer=…)` — the author | one named enabled catalog row, the same two parts by its delivery; informs, never gates |
| any root's `index` / `worktree` / `base..head` | `review_change` — the mind, by judgment | the same two parts under the root's layer; `coupling_only` critics answer `[coupling]` (`review_ledger.seat_parts`) outside the quorum |
| an intention | `plan_task` | the Plan Review Checklist; `ask='council'` = every pool row, `ask=[ids]` = those rows; a body plan's first ask: a marked row, with a reason when narrowed |
| a skill payload | `skill_review` | the Skill Review Checklist; the pool, or named rows with a reason |
| a task result | `review_change(subject="result")` — the mind, or the host at a Required root delivery | one result question; a Required root needs a reason when it narrows, else named rows, host floor `chosen_by=host`; no coupling |
| the running system | `/review` — `review_change(subject=system, surface=system)` | the deep self-review report from one enabled catalog row (default Main); no verdict question |

**One organ per subject.** An intention has one organ, the plan council (`plan_task`, §6 Plan construction and review), where nobody votes. A staged change (commit review, `review_change`) and a delivered result (`review_change(subject="result")`) are frozen subjects whose reviewers answer exactly that; no vote erases a finding and there is no consensus round. A blind-first cross-check of one panel (only the raising seat withdraws) reopens only on recorded evidence: a lone critical FAIL spending the cycles against a passing rest, defects found only in reviewer dialogue, a dominant false-critical cost. Scheduled children are never seats. A helper check is `review_replaced_by_subagents`, host-enriched, never a verdict.

**`## Review`.** The task snapshot's review pool is a semi-stable block after `## Available subagents` (`subagent_runtime.review_facts_block`, via `reviewer_slot_config.review_pool_slots`, never the last execution): `source` (`structured`; `empty`, a readable catalog with no marked row, `pool_empty: true`, `main_self_review: true`; `error`, a malformed catalog or refused document migration; `unknown`, an unreadable document with no frozen catalog), runtime `mode`, a `rule` sentence, per seat `seat_id` (record id), `subagent_id` (catalog handle, else the seat id), `model`, `effort` and `delivery`, and `surfaces`, who reviews where. `coupling_unanswerable: true` (no seat reads the repository: every commit-gate review ends `NOT_PERFORMED`) survives every shrink; `pool_without_credentials` / `no_pool_row_has_credentials` match `GET /api/review-pool` and Settings → Agents; `migration_snapshot` names the deciding migration receipt. `## Review seat activity` (review and plan-ask prices; answers, silences, mean seconds per surface; last review) and `## Review records` (newest, bounded `omitted.records`) ride in the changing part.

##### Subject operation

`ReviewSubjectSpec` (`tools/review_subject.py`) names a wave's root (`system_repo`/`active_workspace`), kind (`index`, `worktree`, `base..head` with base ancestral to head), surface and checklist layer. `freeze_subject` pins `FrozenSubject` once: diff, `diff_sha`, both trees. Reads use the subject root; governance uses the installed body's serving checkout (`governance_root`); bound body candidates supply subjects, never rules.

Only a synchronous gate reads the live system index against HEAD (`is_gate_subject`, `capture_staged_diff`). Other subjects and receptive waves use `isolated_checkout`: a detached parent worktree, frozen patch staged. `checkout_token` pins `state/review_checkouts/<token>/` per task round; open custody keeps it for rejoin. Packets, briefs, rungs, manifests and retrieving seats read it. Non-body subjects skip body release preflight.

Subject identities: reuse covers subject/panel/contract/round, never governance text; the round covers author intent and `since_review`; retry names physical custody. New intent consumes the shared `(repo, tool, root task)` allowance. Rejoins restore paid roster, exhibit and the exact attempt's dispute input (a shared retry key supplies none) before catalog lookup.

`review_change(review_reference=...)` (`tools/review_collection.py`) takes no subject/brief/panel; it collects its original record at $0 (no tests, effects or new cycle), adding masked run answers; a busy lock is recoverable. Only `continue_seats` sends: one successor per offered seat on its original body, window and copy; its read-only checkout is re-owned before each POST (else `subject_unavailable`). Undisposed `commit_reviewed` resumes its paid gate (ordinary enforcement, this call's tests) only on the task's exact uncompacted staged binding; other references, a Continue successor's too, read back or continue old seats unstaged.

Review panel asks accept `wake_on={senders,tasks,runs,reviewers,wake_at}` (`review_waiting.py`): explicit ids only; default whole wave plus mail/controls. Counted reviewer ids pin wave/operation/slot copies. `model_sleep.terminal_readiness` serves all wait adapters: canonical answer/unavailability wakes; raw/pending/extra seats do not. Pause/Stop/owner input/child questions win. Peeks never ACK; transcript stages cursors, checkpoint saves. Prose reparks on install/recheck. Wait/ledger/owed mark keep selectors/cursors; legacy selections survive. Persist record/attempt before subscription; notices name durable revisions. Mail ACK releases no room duty. API loss stays loss; remote live/unknown stays pending. System reports stay synchronous.

##### Change review on any root

`review_change` asks an optional wave on a frozen subject, writes the ledger, never commits; unattached tests stay `NOT_RUN`. It selects active/system/admitted workspaces; bad arguments, missing repositories or empty changes refuse before payment. Acting children review only their write root (no whole-system review, self-approval or commit); readonly children gain none. Parent integration is independent. Rejoin may compose a panel only to choose its retry key; the recorded roster remains authoritative on collection.

`body_fact` selects checklist/composition; `treat_as_body` raises only unknown. `compose_review_panel` uses marked rows outside Cyber Pro (unexplained narrowing refuses at $0) and free composition elsewhere (`reason_missing`); omission means `full_pool`. Marked seats count; added critics do not (Cyber Pro alone: `no_counted_reviewers`, own retry key). `commit_reviewed` shares `commit_gate.compose_commit_panel` before staging through context-local `composed_review_pool` because gate readers lack an argument path. Waves keep separate pools. Effort orders the wave; author questions reach brief/record. FAIL is advice. Body lands via `commit_reviewed`/`vcs_commit_reviewed(root=system_repo)`; other roots use Git.

`review_change_custody.review_state_root` owns attempts canonically, moving, never mirroring, only the re-entering task's legacy child-drive rows. Late readers follow that owner. Paid rows pin `review_budget_repo_key` from host copy provenance: copies share their source's `(repository, review_change, root task)` pool, while physical subject/retry/source identities stay distinct. Parent preflight looks share this pool; commit-gate rows and cycles stay on the committing task's drive, and history reads both. Missing provenance keeps physical identity. The cap is read at admission without concurrent reservation. Exhaustion records `NOT_DISPATCHED/review_cycles_exhausted` only for new waves, never for collection.

##### Review ledger record

`review_ledger.py` owns `state/review_ledger/<record_id>.json`: subject/brief, seats, requested/observed routes, answers, decisions, `commit_landings`, tests/cost. `review_reference` selects; wave/record IDs bind paid actors and attempts/slots. `load_record` distinguishes absent/unreadable. Preflight reads checkout heads; incomplete history stays unknown. Unknown models add no diversity; pending/free refusal stays NOT_PERFORMED/NOT_DISPATCHED. Seat `usd` survives failure; absent/estimated is null. Wave costs retain gaps. Author continuation is no verdict (`evidence_at_decision`; `landing` only after Git). Locked settlement keeps terminal facts/provenance/choices and distinct findings over pending, deduplicating replay and cost. The ledger never gates.

`artifacts.store_actor_source_bytes` keeps texts before indexing; unresolved rows keep bodies (§10.1). Seat roles: `prompt`, current `response`/`failure`; `historical_source_refs`: displaced refs, `pending` notes; readers: `seat_text_source`; a host-stopped wave's note: the panel's `failure` (`wave_failures`). `review_projection` isolates gaps. `gateway/task_reviews.py` serves owner-resolved pages, exact reads (Plan ignores retry aliases; skills: bridge-supported `/api/tasks/`); exports hash safe bytes, full safe causes precede display bounds, no retry/verdict implied.

`review_history.py`, `plan_review_artifacts.py` and `plan_record.record_history` project decisions once via mirrors, keeping unknown fields/paid artifacts. `review_history.subject_comparison` freezes the change since earlier reviews into `dispute_input`. `review_history_view.py`: one 6A `[Current review decisions]` row with verbatim decisions, whole open findings/attachments, addresses for other bodies; appends on change, rewrites retire superseded copies. `compact_context.review_notes` shortens decisions or groups selected history; references bind observed versions, closure/verdicts stay unchanged. Task-result selections keep accounts/lineage in cold context, packets and Continue, including legacy singletons. Reviewer prose keeps authored order/provenance without private capsule bookkeeping; Main/retention keep exact capsules. Invalid transfers keep bodies/reasons; selections are independent. Missing sources stay gaps; no automatic author/read gate.

##### Session identity

`gateways.claudexor.final_attempt_facts` binds model/harness/profile to one final-attempt row in this run's `final/telemetry.yaml`; request/summary echoes and earlier attempts never fill gaps. Live/late facts preserve absence and raw labels; same-spawn catalog proof verifies exact IDs, not inferred effort siblings. Without proof, legacy checks apply. Identity changes neither quorum nor routing; custody/billing remain authoritative.

##### Structural gates

Structural gates measure code size (BIBLE P3). `ouroboros/review.py::iter_gated_modules` supplies the one inventory, test modules excluded, for smoke, `codebase_health`, census and the UTF-8 byte gate. `ouroboros/size_ratchet_manifest.py` is a generated, data-only debt register: exact module-line, function-line and byte debt plus the rationale band (the limits: DEVELOPMENT "Module Size & Complexity"). `validate_size_ratchet` checks live and staged exactness, shrink-only transitions against the committed manifest of `HEAD` or a parent with no history replay, and a reason for each touched 1001–1600-line module (`touched_band_errors`; also pairwise); only readable absence bootstraps from the candidate tree, so a fork inherits no topology debt; an unreadable authority or staged tree keeps the live findings plus a `partial:` finding, never a clean pass. Official-repository CI blocks in the `size_ratchet` pytest lane; local surfaces warn on the same findings; without branch protection a red lane is a signal, not a merge stop.

`context_runtime_facts.storage_fact`/`vitals_fact`, `context_first_hour.py`: dated disk, body and setup facts, never a gate; absent sources omit keys or are named (P5). `scripts/regenerate_inventories.py` verifies frozen owners (§11.1), layout paths (§1), facades (`noqa: F401`, domains) and UI text in `docs/inventories/`; stale output fails.

##### Prompt size, density and windows

`review_helpers.REVIEW_PROMPT_TOKEN_BUDGET` sizes review/plan/result/skill packets. Retrieving/deep seats use `review_native_transcript_bound` for initial layout; tools reach exact sources, including result subjects above that hint. `reviewer_window.window_scaled_reserves` scales reply reserves to usable window and known output maximum.

`usage_accounting.execute_physical_attempt` stores only settled density (`capability_evidence.json`); auxiliary/uncached calls teach none. Main: a recovering refusal's own density > route-bound anchor of the answered bytes (both `context_anchor.py`; known windows kept) > exact route/account/view witness within 2× of the sendable size (raw, capped by usable input) > a Claudexor model's newest of another account (`fresh_model_usage`) > cold. Review: densest fresh exact-model witness or `COLD_START_TOKEN_DENSITY`. `review_admission.density_probe_before_size_refusal` probes a bounded slice before refusing irreducible cold packets.

`reviewer_window.resolve_reviewer_window` shares precedence, refusal caps, account scope and input/total kind. Stale evidence still sizes layouts with provenance. Without evidence, API routes use the full-window layout, raw subscriptions the assembler budget. `scope_window` names provenance. Layout implies no capacity or reviewer authority; failed sends supply no verdict.

##### The coupling question (Part 2 of the brief)

The commit gate runs one wave with one role, the seat, and one quorum (`tools/parallel_review.py`). Every assigned seat receives one brief by its `parts`: a packet seat `[change]` (contract A); a retrieving seat, native API or delegated session in every context mode, `[change, coupling]` (contract B); a `coupling_only` critic of `review_change` `[coupling]`, outside the quorum. `config.adaptive_quorum` counts the seats that answered at least one asked part once, and `review_ledger.reduce_verdict` decides the aggregate for the gate and the record alike (`per_question.change` / `per_question.coupling`); an unperformed coupling question never permits aggregate `PASS`. A native API seat keeps its configured identity, route, account pin and effort while the surface selects inspection delivery.

`review_admission.build_two_part_brief` purely renders the frozen subject and intent. Part 1 carries intent, rebuttal, history, touched-path dispositions, the layered Change Review Checklist, task evidence and exact staged change; Part 2 the Coupling questions, shared governance tiers, repository index and required-source manifest. Stable governance precedes change-relative context for cache reuse. The diff stays inline within the layout hint (`native_first_send_chars`; sessions use `SESSION_INLINE_DIFF_CEILING_CHARS`); otherwise it becomes one exact paged source in the task artifact store, with a byte-exact `.review-drive` view for a delegated session (a skill payload: an index of its hash-bound copy, paged if large, read once beside packet chunks). Native size never refuses a brief. A real preparation failure appends `review_brief_preparation_failed` and blocks the wave as `infra_failure` at $0.

`scope_required_sources.py` declares the change-relative reading minimum: touched protected runtime, prompts and frozen contracts, protection-owned families (`GIT_OPS_FAMILY_PATHS` and tool-dispatch leaves) and declared Python/browser contract twins. An ordinary touched file needs no whole-body obligation: the diff carries its complete change. Each row binds the exact identity a read receipt stamps (`source_revision`, `complete_sha256` / `complete_chars`). `required_sources_ref` and `SCOPE_REQUIRED_SOURCES_POLICY` bind the manifest into the review-contract fingerprint (`commit_gate.commit_review_contract_fingerprint`), so replay authority cannot survive a changed contract. The minimum never restricts further reading.

Coverage records what could be observed — native receipts match source identity and delivered ranges, sessions fold weaker journal evidence over the same rows — as `complete`, `incomplete`, `declared_empty` or `unobserved`; a changed source is a `source_gap`, and inline delivery never proves understanding (plan seats keep `room_delivery` beside `room_read_coverage`). `review_context_atlas.repository_index` supplies orientation only: no bodies, no spend, no limit on what the reviewer may open. The reducer keeps received findings and counts responding seats through `config.adaptive_quorum` apart from coverage: reading gaps are diagnostics that change no status, block no commit and buy no paid review; the agent judges whether a gap needs more reading. Critical findings return to the author; a defective `coupling` block is recorded against that question alone while the seat's `change` answer still counts, and oversize requests, route and candidate-binding failures never become PASS. Retrieval keeps the reading obligation proportional to the change, so repository size never decides whether review can occur; if the change cannot fit a reviewer, split the change, never weaken the reviewer.

##### Governance delivery

`tools/governance_context.py` supplies CODE/coupling briefs for change-review seats, preflight and deep review. Installed governance judges proposals. Native inspection binds `system_repo` to the installation, `active_workspace`/default reads to the candidate, even outside HOME. Body tier 1 inlines BIBLE, CHECKLISTS_ARCHIVE and executing CHECKLISTS surface/`Shared Contract Ownership` sections. Tier 2 budgets review protocol, DESIGN (`web/`: whole, else its bible; other changed words: its bible) and DEVELOPMENT chapters naming touched files; tier 3 adds ARCHITECTURE navigation/relevant packet sections within `runtime_limits.REVIEW_GOVERNANCE_INLINE_SHARE`. Non-inline DESIGN gets its exact-path map; missing sources are explicit. Core/foreign review gets its universal checklist, body books `not_applicable`, `subject_root` navigation and no body-required sources. Retrieving seats may read named sources; tool-less packets disclose undelivered text/uncertainty.
`review_words.py` adds bounded word changes before change diffs and to Result Review.

**The body predicate.** `review_body_fact.body_fact` returns `BodyFact(body ∈ {true, false, unknown}, how, detail)`; `layer_for` maps true to body, all else to core. `how` records the deciding git fact (order/cases: module docstring); branch, directory and remote-name patterns never decide (P5). `treat_as_body` may raise unknown to true, recorded in `detail`, never lower a recognized body. A plan is a body plan by its declared `affected_paths`, copies included (§6 Plan construction and review). `review_checklist.checklist_fingerprint(layer)` records the layered text's sha256 and installed blob (`rules_source`).

##### Guaranteed-fit ladder

The review packet keeps its one-pass fit sequence in `review_admission.fit_triad_prompt` (evidence projection, touched-path note, then `-U0`), keeping every file and hunk identity and every added or removed line; the cold-density rung above may precede the sequence once. Briefs and packets share the disclosed span-only release-carrier cut; the packet also omits governance bodies byte-identical to its inline prefix; managed subjects keep full texts. Every omission is named, and an irreducible oversized packet is a typed refusal; a retrieving seat uses its paged exact subject instead, and a plan ask sizes its delivery and attachments per participant, keeping the constitutional pack a body plan needs.

#### Planning, deep review, post-task work, memory

Plan review, the result review, commit review and deep self-review weigh an intention, a delivered result, a staged self-change and the whole system; none inherits another's authority, and post-task work and memory record execution but approve none of them.

##### Plan construction and review

`plan_task` (`tools/plan_review.py`) is the one organ for an intention (P3): a conversation with the reviewers the mind asks, never a vote; present fields decide the effect. A write (`goal`, `done_when` `[{id, claim, support}]` in `task_contract`'s acceptance-claim grammar, `affected_paths`, prose `plan`) appends a free revision; omitted fields carry over, identical content records nothing. The first revision needs `affected_paths` (`[]` for no files; resolved in the task's workspace/room, else a bound candidate (`planning_roots`); native seats keep candidate READ access beside that folder; serving governance). An ask (`ask="council"` or ids, `message`, `attach`, `reviewer_effort`) is the only paid act and carries the current revision, or before the first a reading (`revision: None`) that moves no objection. No arguments is a free read; waiting is that read or the mailbox wake. Old-form fields get `PLAN_FORM_RETIRED`; every typed `PLAN_*` refusal engages no gate and writes nothing but a no-route ask's attempt.

`tools/plan_ask.py` owns asks and `resolve_participants`: `council` selects `reviewer_slot_config.review_pool_slots`; IDs select pool seats or enabled advisers. Advisers never hold; scheduled children never participate. `plan_is_body` classifies declared changes (new files, not reads) via `plan_spec.resolve_constitutional` and `review_body_fact.body_fact`. Each path's own Git repository qualifies wherever recognized; foreign/unknown stay core. This grants no reads or root changes. Without a manifest URL, the `managed` remote supplies identity. Folderless body research needs `context_requires_self_body_docs=true` and `task_design_source`. The first body ask/reading outside Cyber Pro names marked reviewers, with a reason when it narrows. `reviewer_effort` orders one ask via `row_effort`: the effort range clamps Auto, top by default; pins hold outside Cyber Pro. Weaker orders disclose `ordered_weaker`.

`tools/plan_packet.py` builds delivery: stable role, Plan Review Checklist, `PLAN_REPLY_CONTRACT` and body-only constitutional pack (inline for packet seats, mandatory reads otherwise), then participant content led by `objective_author_line`; the mind never re-sends it. `tools/plan_evidence.py` uses `read_admission`; only own task stores attach within data roots. Text is unrewritten, kind-labelled, omissions explicit; own-file cuts retain full sources through cleanup (`store_actor_source_bytes`, packet/record refs). First asks run blind and parallel; cross-talk adds peers' earlier-ask replies settled since the last delivery, marked late. Repeat participants continue by `review_thread_id` (session) or their last ask's retained texts (packet); unreadable source means a fresh send, shown as `continued`. Released seats settle via the `review_custody` hook `settle_released_reply`, late ones through `attach_late_reply`; mailbox frames count actual settlements. After task end, a reply becomes a mark only the mind releases (`late_review_marks`): full in its room, elsewhere counted in integrating foci's waiting line. Maintenance uses `task_store`'s plan index; the collector rechecks terminality and pending seats at $0. Selection grants no authority. The immutable room `task_source` (`dialogue_evidence.py`, `plan_dialogue.py`) names `chat:<id>@<sha256>`, ranges and gaps. Repeats of one identified quiz decision project once; physical rows stay addressable.

Replies follow `PLAN_REPLY_CONTRACT` (`{prose, objections[{id, text}], withdrawn[{id, why}]}`; the first JSON object with one of those keys; bad items named in `reply.ignored`): only the raiser withdraws; omission keeps an objection (`not_adjudicated`); a foreign withdrawal or unparseable reply changes nothing; prose never holds.

Task-result `plan_record` (schema 3) owns revisions (`plan-revision-NNNN`, inline within 1 MB), asks and typed replies. Gate/readers fold these via `fold_objections`, `gate_projection`, `acceptance_view`; exact texts, cost and custody live in each ask's intention ledger. Its `attach`/`attached`/`omissions` reach immediate/free reads, `record_history`, context readers and Plan details: whole, partial, absent and unrecorded evidence remain distinct. Prepared means neither dispatched nor read. No new status or ledger; money, not `OUROBOROS_REVIEW_MAX_CYCLES`, bounds asks.

The plan gate (`owner_hurry.plan_gate_decision` over `gate_projection`) concerns normal final answers, never edits or commits. No objection holds: open ones are disclosed in the final answer. Unavailability, refusals, silence, pending asks and spent budget never hold; lost custody/dispatch stays unknown (another ask may pay twice); an unreadable record holds outside Cyber Pro (`[PLAN_REVIEW_HOLD]`: read it, or `finish_task(action='stop')`). Swarm creates no plan obligation; a planless task may finish.

The result review's ask binds one route (`review_evidence_sections._accept_effective_claims` over `acceptance_view`): ingress claims win, else the latest revision's `done_when`, open objections or not, beside each revision's `done_when` text, the asks that saw it and the objections open at finalization; ingress never hides adopted plan promises. `plan_record.import_legacy_v2` reads earlier-schema records through one loader (`legacy_facts`, naming an unreadable state): an in-flight task's open blocking findings hold as their seats' objections; reviewers owed at upgrade are one disclosed pending ask (`legacy wave <fingerprint>`) collected read-only as history, never approval of the current revision; selected claims bind with legacy provenance. The Plan panel renders the host fold (`plan_objections`). `review_history_view.current_plan_history` reads `plan_record.record_history` after earlier-schema waves for Reviews history, compaction and a Continue; `plan_review_authority`, `context_health` and predecessor envelopes read the record.

##### Deep self-review

The retained report (`memory/deep_review.md`) is historical evidence, not a current-tree verdict: its provenance header records `generated_at`; `source_revision=unknown` is explicit, since a delivery captures no frozen Git revision. Context carries a source pointer with those header facts (unknown without a header, never the file time) and a qualified reader address; dispatch decides access and the report stays intact.

`/review` is `review_change(subject=system, surface=system)` with one seat: the enabled catalog row the call names (pool member or not), else the direct Main row (`reviewer_slot_config.main_review_row`: Main's model, local flag, pinned account and processing under the pool's settings). The Web selector, `/review [row]` and `request_deep_self_review(reviewer=…)` queue that name; `queue_deep_self_review_task` refuses a row not enabled in the requester's chat before a worker is held; the ack, result and record link reach that chat. A task with `type=deep_self_review` bypasses the tool loop and calls `review_change.run_system_review` (its docstring: the live tree snapshotted before the reviewer reads, `system_tree_moved_during_review` when it moves, the call's own `goal`, `author_questions` and `reason` beside the standing questionnaire), which re-resolves the row under the task's settings. The report is that seat's answer outside the verdict questions, so its one `surface=system` ledger record is never PASS and names the chosen seat even on a refusal. Every row retrieves under `ReviewRequest(surface="deep_self_review")`: an `api_chat` row as a `NativeToolRoundReviewExecutor` episode with the repository and real runtime data roots, an `agent_session` row through its harness with the same task and report contract (markdown, not an output schema; deliveries and header: the module docstring).

Memory is the subject of this review, so both deliveries inline the six-file whitelist byte-exact (identity, scratchpad, registry, WORLD, overview, full knowledge index) and record each file's disposition in the task, in `deep_review_memory` usage and in the report header. Reading gaps are diagnostics and never invalidate a finished report. Typed `deep_self_review_unavailable` or `deep_self_review_error` failures return `execution_status=infra_failed` and leave the previous report intact; `BudgetExceeded` propagates to the budget-pause rail. Availability follows `deep_review_route` (an API row needs credentials for its routed model, a session row a healthy delegated route), never a window floor. These reviewers hold no candidate write authority and run no plan, result or commit reviewers: the report is diagnostic memory, never implementation or publication authority.

##### Post-task work

Lessons are authored, never host-generated, and land where they act: a test, tool, prompt line, setting, skill, scoped note, or a mark kept in view or tied to an action (`mark_anchors.py`; nothing is refused). No context carries the `patterns` body, only its index summary; the `improvement-backlog` body reaches only evolution tasks and the chooser while active. Nothing after a task buys a reflection, rewrites a note or counts, reopens, ranks or closes backlog entries; a merged change is evidence, not proof an intention is met. Accepted cost: with wakes off or after a crash an experience may stay unrecorded; a class the old register named is recalled only through summaries and marks the mind writes.

A root's late phase records free `host_task_facts`; counters keep their producer's attempt through replay. It then runs `memory_fallback.run_fallback_draft` (one Light draft billed as consolidation) and the owner-enabled chooser (§6 Background consciousness and Evolution). Child replicas cannot regress the root's canonical phase; `root_phase_checkpoint` preserves completed stages across Restart. `supervisor/terminal_delivery.py` and `terminal_projection.settle_terminal_projection` own at-least-once delivery and Main/Project mirrors (§3, §5); `terminal_time.py` separates the attempt's end from publication. An owner Pause ends remaining stages at once (`owner_pause:skipped=…`, like Stop), saving nothing. Later roots draft what stays open; maintenance ends an older version's saved Pause the same way, once.

`logs/task_reflections.jsonl` keeps earlier automatic reflections and the late-settlement host rows earlier versions appended; project rows live in their store behind a canonical pointer. No context renders them: `journal_read(source='reflections')` and `read_file` read them. `tool_access_reads.canonical_runtime_reader` addresses canonical bytes, absolute across a fork. Runtime tool/resource restrictions and Presence grants still govern dispatch; without tool context access stays unknown.

The chooser reads a sealed durable package: answer, artifact manifest and `completion_observations`. Full redacted observations stay in canonical artifacts behind explicit `get_task_result(include_completion_source=true)` ranges; a pointer is not proof of reading. `post_task_synthesis.capture_task_inputs` freezes owner words, Q/A provenance and verification receipts before cleanup. `files_rescued` comes from the independent listing: no salvageable text does not mean no files.

Post-work keeps pooled custody apart from early answer delivery and the solve ceiling; Stop, deadline, money and per-call rails stay. Confirmed running precedes paid stages; unpaid preparation failure releases its reservation. Final publication retries only bookkeeping, retaining computed results. `post_task_synthesis.propagate_paid_interruption` stops later paid work on Pause/Stop, the wallet or an unresolved attempt; ordinary errors stay local. Indexed recovery needs absent physical ownership and an unchanged phase/attempt. `pending_once` is replayable only with readable proof of no prior dispatch; paid or indeterminate work degrades without replay; a saved Pause waits for steady recovery. Registry access never waits on checkpoint accounting.

##### Project registry and lease

`projects_registry.py` owns identity, room/folder, lifecycle (`active|deleting|tombstoned`) and routing generation/incarnation. Its file-identity lens shares reserved room IDs and receipt names without sorting; unreadable names stay unknown. A recorded `no_folder` keeps a room folderless until its folder is chosen; `project_folder.py` views a folder and repairs a missing, unusable or unchosen one under `expected` (Project menu, `manage_project_folder`). `project_lease.lane_holders` serializes pooled trees per Project and per recorded folder: a cold root keeps its lanes for open accepted custody or live tree members; with only queued children, its tree reacquires them once all are free. A child starts under its tree's lane or a free one. Delete fences admission, quiesces, then tombstones; history/data survive.

`project_admission.py` freezes `_project_admission`; snapshots, retries, direct results and their restore (`returned_basis`) preserve its folder. Final registry read and queue append hold Q. Admission or Main's fresh seed attests absence (`_project_scope_none`); placement withdraws it. Invalid identity refuses execution/writes; a missing witnessed registry is unknown, reconciliation creates new incarnations (PERSISTENCE). Invalid bases/unreadable authority hold accepted rows, never recapture them. Explicit placement readmits at its next boundary; release persists before dispatch. `prestart_returned_unsent` rechecks the pre-body event's five facts, carried in `resource_limit.returned_before_body` across hold/Resume rewrites, against current start/dispatch evidence. Read gaps preserve source and stop authority: recovery releases scope custody; Quit still needs Resume. Unknown dispatch stays `project_dispatch_unconfirmed`; carrier-free planned handoffs use §9. Refusals keep result/origin as `never_admitted`, without a completion card. Unknown ancestors or continuation sources hold, never replay (§5).

##### Project placement

`project_placement.move_task_to_project` serves mind and button. Durable exact-task binding wins; a new name renames that room, shared origin only proves provenance. Preparation compares routing generation/incarnation. PENDING rows are marked; RUNNING folder/lease stay. Next-boundary readmission revalidates the room and takes its lease, changing only defaults: explicit folders/opt-outs stay; Main body work keeps its own or inherited candidate as recorded `system_repo` intent, which room-lens and scratch defaults read, so consumers agree. Notices distinguish placement from applied readmission, naming the actual folder. Journal/workpad, knowledge and routing follow binding at once, without reloading memory. Children keep scope; Main keeps task identity.

##### Durable memory and project focus

`memory_view_work.py` replaces a completed work's replies with its gist (`wake_summary`: PERSISTENCE) in the same block: whole here, first sentence elsewhere.

`memory_forms.STAGES` orders forms by distance (BIBLE P1, "The subject of continuity"): farther sources yield before nearer ones, older first within each stage. The clean-start guard uses only ordinary forms when they fit the same complete frame with the work room. Unsealed notes yield late; story yields before my human's words, which come last, with human quotes kept beside story pointers until then. Selected accounts lead the story whole, with source changes, no rung. Pointer IDs occur once.

In a place, a recorded person who is not a bot or my outward reply makes a conversation; other arrivals stand as event facts. Unconsidered words in rooms without recorded participation by my human or me may share one fact line per conversation, with their readers.

`memory_view_events.py` counts event rooms per conversation, retaining arrivals and the last author/address/opening. Its catalogue reader, `memory_read(room_id='*', start=…)`, uses a character offset in that start's room catalogue; the catalogue gives each room's row reader.

`HOST_STEPS` selects host forms per mode. `subagent_runtime` supplies review mode/handles and pool exceptions; continuity shows stale attribution, earlier obligations, open continuations and history reader. Roster advice stays whole for routing. Skills share an acceptance legend; both forms keep purpose, trigger and a manifest reader. Always-in-context skill text remains whole. `live_works.compact_other_live_work` counts foreign work, preserving uncertain tails/controls; `update_qualification.compact_qualification` groups reviews by verdict/state/relation/declaration; legacy `not_recorded` and unknown fields survive. Authority, independent roots, budget facts, undeclared fields and vitals survive. `section_floor` retains exact full captures before choosing any form, noting the start's room, the owner's mode budget or the physical window; failed retention leaves full text inline. Identity, scratchpad, marks and overview remain TIER0.

`compact_context` (restricted sets, Nano meta set) keeps typed bindings; concise descriptions state core/owner/tail protection and atomic tool units once. No schema unloading changes Low/Max's full permitted envelope.

`knowledge.body_chars` measures the stored overview body, excluding parsed frontmatter. Its stable residency line travels with the whole loaded revision: Main, tasks, wakes and Presence carry it; helpers read on demand. `knowledge_write` prices the body change in its receipt (`_residency`); effects begin at the next context build, not inside an accepted session's earlier capture. This is a page cost, not a route budget, threshold or automatic rewrite.
What awaits the mind names a closure act, focus and occasion or is not created; counts, oldest dates and exact readers expose it.

Waiting: late reviews, notes, open projects, conversations with my human's recorded participation or my outward reply that no page holds; a silent finish records consideration, not a seal. Rooms without that participation owe no page and no fallback draft. Counted unread words, in their per-conversation line or the global unread count, create no fallback draft work. Projects reopen on owner words/new work. Failed project works are wake facts, not waiting.

`chat_chain.py` probes `state/dialog.sqlite` indexes before room membership; ordinals preserve consolidation offsets and chronicle positions. Only activation and `memory_tail` fill read the whole stream. `Memory.chat_history` freezes a SQL end. Only the importer reads frozen files. Import gaps and unproven retained Project openings stay explicit in room views.

Readers that must prove absence use `dialogue_store.require_imported` (a still-importing or unimportable interval is a typed failure, never an absence) and answer over the readable rows; skipped lines stay disclosed through `range_coverage`: compaction drops no source over a gap, routing keeps the card open with an importing/unavailable response, and quiz host facts check gaps only after the newest known inbound row.

`memory_view.py` renders one captured `ViewSpec`: B holds story; C holds marks, this room and my other conversations. Story entries and authored notes depend on source revision and selected form, never the start allowance; `capture_story` reuses a story only while every source it read answers alike. `memory_floor.py` fits story, this room and other conversations together beside the work reserve. Governing and unanswered owner rows are immune; uncovered owner words and a project root's sealed owner rows may spend work room and yield only under physical pressure, at the owner stage. Nannies keep their room without a common story. A child or nanny starts with the knowledge outline and gets the whole knowledge index with its first accepted delegation's result (`delegation_knowledge_index.py`). `memory_inventory.record_period` derives source periods; unions prove no continuous coverage.

`memory_form_facts.py` supplies the floor receipt. "Holding the room" ranks disjoint kinds by tokens on memory-induced mode lowering or emergency forms of read/spoken/retold sources, pricing hidden remote untold words whole. Full receipts merge kinds at a reader and name up to three largest distinct readers, with rooms/ranges holding counted rows. Nano and retained `physical_floor` stages show only totals by kind. On inspect, `ordinary_composition` maps spans to forms, refs and gaps. Its digest reader survives issuer changes and cold restores.

`context_memory_view` carries a build's `sections_ms`, `sections_cpu_ms` and `work` (`context_timing.py`). Pricing builds a piece's text once per key and keeps its length; delivery builds the texts it sends (`MemoryViewSnapshot.piece`; law: `tests/test_cost_contract.py` L7). The collector rests during a build (`collector_rests`).

`chronicle_store.py`: accounts freeze source IDs/revisions/hashes/draft states and verify quotes; seals/folds/heads stay. Latest `selection` shows/withdraws accounts with named replacements; receipts count teller relations, not displacement. `memory_read(proposed_selection=…)` previews in one capture story/room views, whole told/stop-telling records and a start fit (`counterfactual_starts`). `memory_view_account.py` renders composition/readers. Corrections/rejections stay whole until a new account cites corrected direct versions; uncited told records keep theirs. Edits/reselection keep old edges. Decisions/folds/gaps/nested changes stay explicit; parts bind no member revision.

`context.py` assembles governance, semi-stable memory and dynamic task facts. `Memory.read_task_recent`/`jsonl_tail.py` read each task's newest rows, never a filtered global tail; `checkpoint_waits.py` adds uncounted host waits. Coverage names progress SQL/import gaps, tools/events windows and unopened archives: gaps forbid “all matching rows”. Children read tools/events on their execution drive, progress in canonical dialogue. Scratchpad is the mind's agenda: whole blocks (`SCRATCHPAD_SECTION_BUDGET_CHARS` only logs), folded only by accepted `update_scratchpad(replaces=…)`. `context_layout.py` owns reference forms.

**Writers.** `tools/chronicle.py` publishes pages, parts, notes, corrections, decisions, accounts and selections; `{to}` covers still-open rows before its end, with `conversation` its conversation's rooms'. `note_ids` seals notes. A standing part replaces its members' text in their room. `kind='decision', accepted=false` withdraws a draft, own or accepted page/part, reopening rows or unfolding members; an acting containing part must be withdrawn first. The original stays readable. `close_project` seals open rows with its closing note; `memory_sealing.py` links later terminal rows and a closure notice outside coverage. `memory_fallback.py`: ON writes nothing; OFF/delegated drafts act at once, reversibly, on the mind's pages too after a crowded start, OFF also folded other conversations. Exact refusals/rejections suppress repeats; quotes are verified, accounts structured. `dialogue_provenance` renders recorded finality/authority through history, stamps and links: preliminary host facts never become final by omission. `consolidator.py` owns Light transport; `RoomLabelResolver` labels rooms. Receipts: PERSISTENCE.

Only a page, part or note whose `metadata.lead_rule` records that its writer was shown the lead instruction (`chronicle_lead.py`; carriers: PERSISTENCE) may yield to its first sentence as a telling; without it, an opening is an emergency.

`tools/knowledge.py` adapts `knowledge.py`. `knowledge_read` prefixes readable-shelf facts: present/unwritten addresses, external-link count, backlinks (archives labelled), exact ranges/revisions. `knowledge_backlinks` scans readable shelves by scope/topic on demand; no graph. `knowledge_versions.py` reads journal outlines/history/versions/receipts (`knowledge_read`, `memory_read(source=…)`); wakes group other foci's writes past accepted offsets by page in first-write order: count, distinct writers, first/last times, latest reader. Bad rows skipped/named; lost journals re-baselined. `knowledge_write` assumes no mode; it and `memory_texts.py` (`update_identity`, `update_world`, `workpad_write`) atomically edit read revisions or revert verified versions. Refusals write nothing; no automatic note writer. `world_profiler.py` refreshes the measured block in `WORLD.md`, the mind's map, at startup; identity and map load whole.

Archive/restore preserve body/path and share write lock, revision checks and previous/next history. Writes retain `archive: {at, reason}`; restore removes it. Whole indexes keep active summaries or `(no summary)`; outlines keep active addresses/titles and summaries typed `person…`. `knowledge_residency` receipts locate notes. Archives remain readable/listable, Presence topics included. Linked active overviews retain meaning/limits; no backlink gate/classifier. Only `overview` stays active; `patterns` and `improvement-backlog` keep their global addresses as ordinary notes. Navigation reuses file-identity-validated descriptors; `markdown_source.py` projects titles without full parsing. Shelf scaling/stale authored prose remain limits.

Lifecycle publication first captures exact previous text in existing actor-source custody in canonical/execution reader roots (`knowledge_previous_source.read` via `read_file` on `artifact_store`): generic file tools cannot read project history. `review_source_closure.py` carries that host handle through child-source retention and cleanup.

Project work prefers its thread, journal, workpad and knowledge; digests touch technical activity. Project shelves sit under `canonical_data_root`; children inherit the root's resolved project id, never derive it. Identity, the world map and scratchpad stay canonical, not project copies. `tools/project_journal.py` owns curated `journal.jsonl` milestones and active `workpad.md` with its history; context holds the whole workpad with its revision, recent journal and older-entry pointers. No size refuses a page; with no step-down form, a page past a route's window leaves its project's requests unfit until folded from Main, which writes any project's page; `update_focus` keeps its own 256 KB evidence bound and cannot page a workpad source. At root completion only high-signal blockers, questions and interface contracts pass from tree ledger to journal. Scheduled consciousness reads results, not digests.

#### Skills and extensions

Independent gates (§13): discovery/manifest (`skill_loader.py`, `contracts/skill_manifest.py`), hash-bound review (`skill_review.py` → `review_change(subject="skill")`, `skill_review_runner.py`), grants, dependencies (`skill_dependencies.py`, `marketplace/isolated_deps.py`), enablement and execution. Discovery records identity/source/provenance (`.self_authored.json`), conflicts and hash, not trust. `skill_readiness.py` composes `state/skills/<name>/` facts and conflicts via mode-aware `gate_for(executable_review)` for `tools/skill_exec.py` and extensions. Owner attestation (`skill_owner_attestation.py`) skips LLM review for any skill's exact bytes, never preflight; other acceptance is §13's. `list_skills`, Installed Skills and `/api/extensions` share facts; enablement emits best-effort actor-named `skill_enabled_changed`. Cyber advice is not PASS.

`skill_context_snapshot.py` appends granted local facts before sealing; no callback/network/model. Atomic bundles, `extension_liveness.live_context_publishers` and worker adoption share review/readiness/revocation. A full text shows once; a change, lapse or failure adds one note naming its reader, no more until a rebuild. Failed retention keeps text. `loop_messages` separates owner speech (answered cards: `reply_to`) from host/review data; serializers keep untrusted framing. See CREATING_SKILLS "Passive context snapshots".

A connector declares `provides: place`; a place's choices live in one host record (`places.py`, §12) a connector update never overwrites. A matching event focuses consciousness in the place room: a consciousness turn under the owner's autonomy and allowance, no capability ceiling, on the connector turn carrier (§12). A working folder changes the file/process target, keeping canonical shared memory; it derives no Project scope or forked drive. The place migration reads an old behavior skill's `presence:` block once; frozen old task ceilings stay decodable for retained work.

`extension_loader.py` and the isolated-dependency layer load only a ready, hash-matching extension (in-process via `PluginAPIImpl`, isolated-dep/native ones as child-process proxies); each reads the installation's whole memory via `read_memory` (`memory_reader.py`) with no permission. `skill_lifecycle_queue.py` (§13) exposes queued/running/succeeded/failed and stale metadata, recovery evidence that never unlocks a running thread. `skill_payload_binding.resolve_skill_payload_base` fills an omitted skill name or bucket from the selected `TaskConstraint`; explicit selectors must resolve to the same physical payload. A selected-skill repair (`skill_repair_admission.py`, §13) is admitted against an immutable `base_content_hash` and checks `expected_content_hash` before each payload write; drift makes it STALE, with no long shell lock, rollback or blocked writer.

##### Skill publication

The passive installed-skill projection never launches Betterleaks or claims current bytes publication-ready (`skill_publish_eligibility.py`). Selecting Publish calls `POST /api/skills/{skill}/publish-preflight` (`gateway/skill_publish.py`, read-only), which captures and scans one current payload, recomputes review staleness and returns exactly one backend-authored state (`ready`, `warnings`, `needs_attention`, `repairable`, `hard_block`); the browser only renders it; only `hard_block` prevents task creation. Flow:

`passive index (no scan) → preflight → explicit confirmation → managed task → lifecycle-lane capture (bytes, destination, install provenance; review kept separate) → release lane → payload scan → read-only GitHub comparison → derived scans → first mutation → validated same-skill PR receipt → completion`

Publication authority is `skill_publish_eligibility.publication_author_acceptance`: fresh publishable critic authority or qualified current author authority; owner attestation alone is not that chain, and catalog hashes and PR receipts never become review PASS. Every outbound byte derives from the capture (`skill_publish_snapshot.py`), never a reread live payload. Outside Cyber Pro, Betterleaks `high` findings (`skill_publish_scanner.py`) block the outbound call; lower or unknown confidence is a redacted warning; Cyber keeps scanner and review results as independent advice. Publish never downloads Betterleaks (§8). Planning (`skill_publish_destination.py`: origin, hub entry or the owner's source) replaces what its install record's release does not explain only on the mind's decision bound to that comparison. A `skill_publish` task (`tools/skill_publish.py`) is accepted only when its pre-truncation metadata holds a validated pull-request receipt for the requested skill and its destination's repository; the receipt proves the observed publication.

Owner lifecycle actions share `skill_lifecycle_actions.run_skill_action`: grant/toggle run in the lifecycle lane, local delete uses `skill_uninstall_state`, and attestation keeps its deterministic floor. The host supplies actor identity and checks exact resource/revision plus an existing chat message, answered quiz or owner-mailbox record when owner intent is needed; the model interprets that source. A generated edit-and-review request confers no grant, attestation, deletion or enable authority: a client `allow_enable` flag authorizes nothing, Presence ceilings come first, a newer owner disable in `enabled.json` wins, and a Repair review never auto-enables; the model chooses `toggle_skill`. There is no permission ledger and no HTTP impersonation. `skill_exec` returns the revision captured before its script launch, and extension tool receipts carry the descriptor's `content_hash` only after physical dispatch; neither is review PASS or a semantic test verdict. Install rollback and the publication receipt: §13.

`mcp_client.py`: HTTP/SSE/stdio, `mcp_<server>__<tool>`, `schemas_at_start`; `mcp_catalog.py`: instructions/tools, seeded before turns. Missing catalogs never block; adoption/attempts/cache provenance: DEVELOPMENT §12.

Pre-Safety resolution never lists inline (`mcp_catalog.MCPNameResolution`; unready skills: `MCP_SKILL_UNAVAILABLE`).
