`mcp_result_images.py` keeps image/blob responses exactly; an embedded blob becomes a registered artifact (errors too), else a description, never base64; only images attach as pixels; URIs are never fetched (docstring).

Own Node consumers (skills, companions, attach, Playwright's driver) run the pin's Node, prepared or exactly shipped, never an older one or `PATH`, unless chosen (`PLAYWRIGHT_NODEJS_PATH`, manifest `PATH`) or the host lacks a pinned archive (warned); web tests may name a `PATH` Node. Boot selects it before extensions; boot and acting consumers prepare it single-flight, re-queuing enabled extensions not live. Children get it unrun; boundaries carry it (`OUROBOROS_PINNED_NODE_CARRIED`); `OUROBOROS_PLAYWRIGHT_NODE_SELECTED` marks an automatic driver.

Sessions bind before Safety (`browser_call_scope`); each generation's async Playwright owns a loop (`tools/browser_session.py`): pages load between calls, and a request no call made meets Pause and immediate Stop. Only replacements advance generation; a timeout retires a session, closed after settlement or at task end; late calls cannot adopt/close replacements. Overflow refuses `BROWSER_BACKLOG_RETIRED_SESSIONS`, an installing engine `BROWSER_PREPARING`; hangs use the outer timeout (no process isolation). `iframe.contentWindow` stealth is off (broke srcdoc widgets). Chromium is only the `chromium_runtime.py` pin (macOS 13+), sandboxed unless `OUROBOROS_CHROMIUM_SANDBOX=off`, no fallback; observations disclose engine/version/stealth/requested sandbox beside `producer_text`, not anti-bot/isolation efficacy. WebKit/devices target Safari/iOS risks.

`browser_policy.py` judges targets, scripts and owner-control HTTP shapes against three-valued service identity (unreadable owner POST bodies refuse; empty ones stay ordinary). Cyber root/acting requests keep control/target reach; readonly contracts still bind. Live `state/server_port.bindings.json` proves our endpoints; unverified expected endpoints (`state/server_port`, `state/server_process.json`, Host Service config, local-model custody) refuse as unknown (`server_process.runtime_service_identity`). Other ports are ordinary; unclassifiable restricted DNS refuses `BROWSER_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE`. `tools/browser.py` rechecks `redirected_from` after redirects (sent hops stay sent); the guard's limits: `tools/browser_session.py`.

`usage_accounting.py` owns `reserved → dispatched → settled | unresolved` or proven-unsent release; dispatched release needs engine no-inference proof. Retries get new ids; unsent preparation keeps identity/custody. `_usage_wait.py` retries rolled-back contention outside admission locks. **Planning threshold** (`task_pacing.py`). One unreserved `CostCeiling` (`disabled`, `active`, `exhausted_soft_land`, `unknown`) supplies loop checks and `in_task_cost_ceiling`. Ordinary tasks have `no_default_cost_stop`; explicit `cost_hard_stop_pct` selects the lesser of a global-remainder share and root-cap margin. A producer allowance, such as a wake's remainder, stops at its actual value. Descendants inherit the root's authority; cold restores re-read it and keep an unreadable policy as `legacy_policy_unverified`, never widen it. Monetary admission is separate.

`loop_budget._check_budget_limits` runs after unfinished spending rounds, with or without tools, but never adds a paid final after READY. Eligible tasks pause. Other actors use a priced terminal rail only when an explicit profile permits and money admission fits (`budget_wrapup_unaffordable` otherwise); producer or unverified limits end with an unpaid host notice. Unknown price fails open, unknown spend is not zero, and an affordability probe reserves nothing. `_usage_cache_splits.py` reuses settled exact-route cache observations for estimates. `task_pacing.main_loop_wire_options` owns the complete outgoing shape; pre-send identity drift refuses `forced_candidate_drift`, with one ledger-priced unpredicated terminal retry so the answer is not lost.

`budget_pause.py` fences pooled/direct work and text Presence, settles producers, saves `owner_wait.continuation_state` and parks the same id without a paid final. Money fences trees. A technical pause parks one member; a known cause wakes it by the exact grant once readable, an unknown legacy one awaits Resume. Missing owner/stable save failure: `exact_pause_unavailable`. Positive seed-lock or rolled-back store contention retries the same seed/prepared source under Stop/Panic/deadline/cancel; ambiguous external publication holds. Money pauses need delegated-stop proof; unknown coverage admits no writer.

`work_stop.current_stop` reads installation → tree → member; independent member stops survive tree release. Owner/budget fences, then explicit `_budget_pause_hold`, then a live exact/zero-dispatch marker decide. Owner markers without a closed fence await selection; sleep is a wait. One table gives cause/release and shared words. `by` owns attribution; point `refusal` keeps Resume visible for recheck. Release deletes the stop with selection; history cannot restore it.

All Resume doors (`queue_transitions`, `budget_resume`, mind child/Continue selection) read `release_refusal`: Panic holds need the owner; other stops permit Resume, rechecking source, fresh money, Stop/restart, time and ancestry. Addressed actions repair ended local recipients; live writers refuse with named blockers. No live execution means Paused + Resume, model/external tails apart; only live execution is Pausing. Saved exact/native work survives read gaps. Sourceless owner seeds keep `unsaved_pause_intent`.

`events_budget` separates cause-free `_resume_selection` from single-use exact grants. `root_resume_basis` binds actor/grant/fence, not time; consumption keeps Q9 choice, never permits replay. No-fence Resume supersedes bound choices and rebinds unbound ones, reissuing no grants. Dispatch rechecks root generation; a new Pause invalidates old choices. `retain_consumed_selection` keeps root lending identities; `owner_pause.consumed_member_resume` repairs missed selection. `resume_paused_loop` saves unanswered calls, model, effort, attempt, spend and execution time before consumption; spent/revoked/foreign grants refuse. OS handles never return; only explicit graceful profiles allow a fitting final reservation.

##### The model's own sleep

`await_messages`, `wait_task` and `wait_tasks` sleep by default; delivery obligations save before release. Explicit `mode="in_slot"` (`sleep_mode` on task and delegate waits) keeps the process and same-call window/result within task bounds, yielding acting capacity via `in_slot_wait`. A zero timeout peeks unless `await_messages` selects sleep sources; without a continuation owner the default stays in-process. Warm/cold are explicit, never inferred from duration.

`model_sleep.py` rechecks canonical sources (selected senders, task/run terminals, service exits (warm only) or time) after installing the wait, losing no wake to read errors/contention. Owner input, descendant mail and true `place_arrival.wake` always wake, false never (absent: mail); own-run questions wake mid-run. Polls batch typed statuses (warm traces a failure streak once); refresh failure keeps known readiness; terminal, collection, money, success differ. Services pin one start: exit gives its code, loss/unreadability wakes as unknown.

Warm sleep keeps stack, browser, actor and lane via `owner_wait`, lending acting capacity (§5). Cold saves source/attempt/clocks; browser/REPL loss is disclosed and owner questions stay warm. Ordinary cold sleep may transfer exact runs via `sleep_custody.py` after dispatch closes and body acceptance commits; authorship and cross-carrier discovery stay. Sleeping parents never stop live or queued children; project leases, owner Pause, money and Stop still bind the tree.

`continue_in_background(reason)` parks a conversation-lane turn's same id for the project pool after the completed batch (already-pooled attempts no-op); admitted profile/ceilings stay; exact bound runs transfer as in cold sleep; services and own, ended or unreadable custody refuse.

A receipt binds sleep/pause identity/generation, attempt, source, runs and workspace; runtime identity is provenance. Restart rebinds before orphan recovery, keeping stop holds and external-run fate. Unconfirmed acceptance proves no host absence: awake return needs exact withdrawal of the unaccepted request and reopened fence. Acceptance wins its race; unknown withdrawal stays interruptibly held. Requests/readiness grant no release, Continue, new root or child choice.

Ready tools and normal wakes expose exact question refs, concurrent too; controls skip fresh reads. Delivered views update retained exposure (not answers; cold retry rolls back, legacy may repeat). `dependency_held` shows once per stop/`root_resume_basis` before park, never waking. `sleep_wake.py` records readiness off Q without HTTP. Automatic and explicit returns name their wake and observe without stopping: exact body custody returns the same actor over live or unsettled runs, granting no stopped-work resume or external-exit proof; untransferred writers hold; independent critics keep their controller. Money, owner fences, time, capacity and single-use grants still bind.

Warm and lane-retaining cold refuse selected queued roots needing their lane. Manual Restart/Panic hold sleep for Resume; ordinary cold sleep (not detach) drops stale handoffs; ready cold sleep wakes unless held. Clock recovery matches task/attempt/grant/source, not nested root metadata, and grants no execution.

`pause_task` uses `request_owner_pause`; Resume shares grants and `by` (`resume_author`). No plan/finish authority passes; unreadable plan sources become `plan_review_source_gap` while the successor starts.

##### Saved working state and application stops

`working_checkpoint.py` saves one `source_handles/working/` state per attempt via `owner_wait.continuation_state` (format: PERSISTENCE; save boundaries/atomicity: module docstring). `owner_wait.governing_continuation` selects owner wait, exact pause, then working recovery; invalid sources never fall through. Restore precedes startup receipt minus restored mail. Startup/tool wakes stage exposure before save (unsaved mail: the module docstring).

`owner_wait.rebind_restored_route` recaptures each start. `continuation_tools.py` reconciles tools when `transcript_prefix._baseline` is missing or mismatched, or a fresh profile supplies a missing gateway. It fits fresh tools and current definitions of saved, loaded and ceiling-left names against history; recovered bytes stay frozen.

`worker_health` (same-ID crash) and `workers.kill_workers` (planned successors) freeze `_working_recovery` before queueing; load retires the rolling file; failed freezes keep a gap. Invariant 31 binds replay. Delegated runs stay facts; saved candidates buy no generation. A `task_reaper` timeout queues no successor. Reads verify lineage bytes, own store first (PERSISTENCE).

Restart/updates name returns in `restart_retention.prepare_restart_returns` (§9; invariant 31); native waits keep carriers (age: §5). Updates save handoffs before stopping (failure blocks update); Rollback saves none. Refused returns emit `restart_return_refused`. Cold continuation keeps economics, deadlines/wait time and same-requester/attempt Restart intent, rereading cost authority (`task_pacing.restore_cost_ceiling`). `retained_for_boot` exempts update-stopped RUNNING from timeouts, never death checks. `recover_aborted_update` parks captures after confirmed teardown, saves PENDING before reopening writers/releasing dead project leases. Pool startup grants no return.

##### Monetary authority and projections

**Live global limit.** One agent resolver reparses saved settings on change, falling back uncached to the environment. Workers refresh it at task start; live file reads keep reservation/wallet `TOTAL_BUDGET` current; planning thresholds stay separate. Absent uses the shipped default; non-positive means unbounded, silencing the loop's global axis. A pre-load launcher cap (`OUROBOROS_REVIEW_RUN_CAP_USD`, isolated contributor review only) replaces the saved budget for that empty-ledger process tree; unreadable caps yield zero allowance.

`pricing.py`: bounded catalog lookup for the sealed route (`llm_routing.attempt_pricing_fields`); no manual tables, prefix/fallback prices or admission allowlists. Unbound rows or empty pools leave bounds unknown. Reserve and dispatch check settled spend; global binds paid admission only (`paid_admission`; dispatched rows park only with saved work). Holds and unresolved bounds are exposure; late or concurrent charges can overshoot. Unknown price reserves None; settle reported cost, a later exact price or DeepSeek’s pre-send entry and key currency from `/user/balance` (`pricing_catalog.pin_tariff`), else None/non-final. `usage_admission.review_wave_admission` checks global/root/group for skill, plan, task and commit; session-only plans still check root/group. Bounds disclose estimates; managed update only records them (`managed_update_wave_estimate`). Unpayable seats bypass without substitution; unpriced seats stay disclosed beside priced siblings.

**Whole-work billing group.** `usage_admission.py` separates task/root/parent ids from `billing_group_id`/`billing_group_limit_usd`. One store transaction checks global/root/group for successors and original-root late work too. Continue uses initial `billing_group`, else earliest live ledger authority, else configured cap (`legacy_default`). Review-wave `binding_axis=group`, pacing and strict Resume share it; only the group owner amends its cap. `task_money_snapshot` keeps root/group axes over shared spend. Unestablished authority refuses typed, never as money or a stand-in group/zero; late overruns bar admission without a bill guarantee; standalone UI/marketplace contexts declare a non-task role. Reservations keep applied global limit/unbounded, source and revision through transitions.

Root Details `GET /api/tasks/{id}` derives `cost_breakdown` from the store (own/child/unattributed, purpose/route, sessions, unknowns, finality): no persistence or third sum; unreadable/unattributable ledgers omitted. Each physical review send emits `llm_usage` by wave/slot (`review_records.resolve_review_wave`); skill seats use review-ledger rows, delegates their own observed, never inferred, provider/model. `state.json`, task results, `llm_usage`, `/api/state` and `/api/cost-breakdown` are compatibility projections. Drive state shows dated paired OpenRouter deltas, not `/status` warnings.


## 7. Configuration (ouroboros/config.py)

Settings have one home and default; the table projects `config.SETTINGS_DEFAULTS`, never a second authority.

`ouroboros/config.py` re-exports paths, settings/env readers and writers, normalization, runtime mode, skills location and PID lock; leaves own defaults/vocabularies (§10.3). `settings_scales.setting_effect` owns the six presentation timings (§3), independently of actor snapshot policy. `update_channels.py` owns update defaults.

Paths use `OUROBOROS_*` overrides or `launch_roots`' pre-import `APP_ROOT` (`~/Ouroboros`). A direct server defaults `REPO_DIR` to its checkout; with only `APP_ROOT` it refuses if `~/Ouroboros/data` may contain memory. `resolve_port_file` moves only the hosting root's port file. Unset work roots follow witness basis: older data uses `~/Ouroboros`, otherwise `APP_ROOT`; unknown refuses. `settings.json` under the data root requires its lock for writes. `secret_masking.py` repairs only disk-recognized placeholders before env precedence, never masking real env credentials. With `OUROBOROS_SETTINGS_SHA256`, `settings_integrity.py` treats the isolated child's seeded snapshot as an owner-authored trust root: reads verify every byte without a sibling lock; all writers refuse.

`openrouter_attribution.py` owns app identity (URL, title, categories; forks own theirs); compatible endpoints get it only at `https://openrouter.ai`:443, no userinfo, on a no-redirect client or unlabelled.

#### Reading and writing the settings document

Tasks privately keep their entry Context/Effort, review settings and catalog (`TaskSettingsSnapshot`); route keys (`route_choice.ROUTE_SETTING_KEYS`) read the saved document as it is now (none saved: as every other key). Absent/empty differ; route overrides win; a deployment policy reads last. Cognition stays private through Resume; fallback uses pre-room env. `RoomResolver` follows lineage/conversion. `composer_cognition.py` freezes legacy rooms before Main changes; new projects copy Main's Effort and Subagents and start in Max. Subagents stays live: Main's `OUROBOROS_SUBAGENTS_MODE` or project `cognition.subagents_mode`, default Auto, including legacy rooms. It bypasses checkpoints; Settings only masks it. `metadata.lead`: CLIENT_CONTRACT §9; `route_choice.py`. Main effort is independent of helper bounds (`_effort_range_format=1`). Immediate keys, writers, granted skill keys and process `env_from_settings` read current disk, including clears; credential-free skill children reread it, payloads carry operator variables. Access stays boot-pinned; reload failures disclose prior env and missing values.

`normalize_settings_raw()` runs before defaults in `load_settings`, `_owner_read_settings_raw` and `build_colab_settings`; dropped keys stay dropped. Colab budget/mode: launch > saved Drive > fresh 200/advanced; workers have no default cap. `safety_config.normalize_consciousness_safety` seeds absent coverage from saved owner coverage; explicit choices stay and guards compare the disk-derived value. `review_pool_migration.apply_at_read_seam` maps run seats to roster rows, retaining refused values. Retired keys/comma-lists drop with notice; comma-only/lane-free installs get factory rows. Review env keys are inert (one startup notice). Reads are pure/idempotent. The loader proposes unauthored slots (§2); `apply_runtime_provider_defaults` only respells them, unpersisted. `apply_settings_to_env` marks slot echoes in internal `OUROBOROS_PROJECTED_PROPOSALS`, inherited by children, distinct from operator variables. Provider Test (minus the search Model) and credential plans (its route legs) share `provider_models.ACTIVE_MODEL_SETTING_KEYS`, including Safety pins; blank inherits.

Unmarked saved `OUROBOROS_MAX_WORKERS` 10 (Colab's first-launch 1; an explicit launch value wins), `OUROBOROS_MODEL_MAX_CONCURRENCY` 3 and `OUROBOROS_MAX_ACTIVE_SUBAGENTS_PER_ROOT` 6 read empty until a save marks them (`_UNCHOSEN_SAVED`); others stay; typos: 10/3/6. Normalization drops retired `OUROBOROS_DELEGATE_WAIT_SEC`/`OUROBOROS_DELEGATE_WAIT_MAX_SEC`; no wait-window setting remains.

`HOST_MEMORY_RESERVE_FRACTION = 0.10` is the shared code constant for process/test memory admission and the test overload stop (DEVELOPMENT §9), not an owner setting.

Optional bounds: `OUROBOROS_MAX_ROUNDS`/`OUROBOROS_TASK_ABS_CEILING_SEC` use `parse_positive_or_unlimited` (also review cycles). Money, deadlines and Stop/Panic still bind; silence triggers attention (§5). Legacy missing keys retain 200 rounds/21600 s (`OPTIONAL_BOUND_LEGACY`); blank, zero, negative or malformed values also take those finite defaults, logged and announced once by `upgrade_notices.py`. Readers return `None` for unlimited. Operations take only true bounds (window, deadline, finite execution), else none.

Five writers use `serialize_settings()` for exact bytes. `config.save_settings`, `owner_settings._owner_update_settings`, `packaged_cli._save_settings` use `prepare_settings_for_persist`: unreadable disk refuses, then deployment policy, disk-authored silence, context/Safety ratchets. Exceptions: the raw compat pair via `context_mode_compat.normalize_and_persist_context_mode_compat`; `colab_bootstrap.write_colab_settings` for foreign roots (own: `_owner_write_settings`). All run `review_pool_receipts.persist_write_receipts` before replacement. `tests/_shared.py::settings_writers` rejects a sixth writer.

`owner_settings._owner_update_settings` checks preconditions, saves canonical settings and captures the receipt and per-key tokens under one file lock. In-process writers hold `settings_document_mutation` through projection. Generic saves bind to the read digest, reread and remerge the original body on a miss, then return 409 on a second miss. Incidental saves (launcher, worker `set_tool_timeout`, resolved GitHub repo) preserve other fields via `fields_on_saved_document`.

GET reads values and `_meta.tokens` together. Tokens hash canonical value and presence, excluding scalar secrets. Conditional writes check only named keys under lock. Ordinary scalars use last-writer-wins. Generic and owner receipts use the audit sanitizer to withhold secrets and structures (`record_settings_change`, declared origin, Main row per DESIGN). A mode switch dates one `context_mode_changed` System row under the lock and sends it to the changed room so its history carries the choice. CLIENT_CONTRACT §9 covers fields, codes, absent keys and saved/failed/unknown outcomes.

#### LLM output token budgets

OpenRouter/Anthropic-compatible output budgets use `max_tokens`; direct OpenAI uses `max_completion_tokens` (Responses: `max_output_tokens`), never by model name (§10 invariant 13). Budgets are floors, lowered by a known route maximum; constants own the numbers:

| Surface | Output-token budget |
|---------|---------------------|
| `LLMClient.chat()` / `chat_async()` defaults | 65,536 |
| Main task loop (`loop_llm_call.MAIN_LOOP_MAX_TOKENS`) | 65,536 |
| `LLMClient.vision_query()` and VLM tools (`analyze_screenshot`, `vlm_query`) | 32,768 |
| Review synthesis dedup | 16,384 |
| Light memory drafts (`consolidator.LIGHT_ANSWER_CEILING_TOKENS`) | 16,384 |
| Post-task evolution promotion decision (`post_task_evolution`) | 8,192 |
| Skill publish PR body generation | 8,192 |
| Project naming LIGHT one-shot (`project_naming.llm_project_name`) | 256 |
| Provider Test (`llm_probe`; direct OpenAI's tool call 4,096) | 16 |

Naming/translation share one deadline across preparation, slots and recovery; naming captures it before scheduling so workers cannot renew it. Earlier bounds win; detached naming refreshes cost without publishing a title.

| OUROBOROS_EFFORT_DEEP_SELF_REVIEW | (migrated) | Retired surface default: consumed into the deep-review helper row at load; env inert |

| OUROBOROS_REASONING_SUMMARY | auto | Readable reasoning-summary rendering; presentation-only, never added to history or returned to providers |
| OUROBOROS_TASK_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SEC | 900 | Silence-attention threshold: no real own/subtree progress (§5); direct-chat outage/accounting-wait bound (§6) |
| OUROBOROS_TASK_ABS_CEILING_SEC | unlimited | Optional absolute task lifetime in seconds, activity-independent |
| OUROBOROS_SUPERVISOR_LIVENESS_DEADLINE_SEC | 90 | Liveness watchdog; alerts and recommends `/restart`, never frees a wedged turn's lock |

##### Review pool

The review pool is the enabled rows of `OUROBOROS_SUBAGENTS` marked `review_eligible: true` (Settings → Agents, the Reviewer mark; `reviewer_slot_config.review_pool_slots`, in the task's settings scope): one list for helpers and reviewers. Effort and delivery are row properties: `effort` is the owner's pin, empty = Auto (`reviewer_slot_config.row_effort`: model name, else pin, else a wave's order clamped into the range, else its top); an API row's `delivery` is `native` (the default, the two-part brief with inspection tools) or `packet`, for a model positively known not to support tools (quota, timeouts, unknown capability or fallbacks never imply it); a session row always retrieves. Only sessions and managed-model API routes may pin `route.credential_profile_id` (empty = rotation). A marked row switched off leaves the pool silently; a row a call names (`review_change(reviewers=[…])`, `preflight_reviewer`, `/review`) that is off or unknown is refused (`catalog_review_row`), never rerouted. A pool with no reading row asks no seat the coupling question: every body commit review ends `NOT_PERFORMED` until a reading row is marked; Save only warns (`subagent_runtime.review_pool_save_warning`).

The generic Settings save, the owner Safety model endpoint, the wizard and the migration share one judge (`reviewer_slot_config.review_pool_save_error`; both settings endpoints use `review_pool_save_judgement` for changed catalogs): a malformed catalog refuses Save and every review surface; a catalog with rows but no mark saves only with the owner's explicit `allow_empty_review_pool`. A never-configured install (no catalog or lanes key: Docker or Colab without the wizard) re-mints its factory catalog over the environment-merged read until saved, following changed defaults. Reviewers (`subscription_install_presets.factory_review_rows`) follow the reachable Main: an OpenRouter Main (or no access yet) gets the three `OPENROUTER_REVIEW_DEFAULTS`, a MiniMax Main its Main, Light, Light, any other Main one row of its route (quorum 1 of 1); a Main the access cannot run mints nothing, naming `OUROBOROS_MODEL`. Only this cell adds Auto helpers (`factory_actor_rows`, with OpenRouter its `OPENROUTER_HELPER_DEFAULTS`). An operator's environment catalog (never our echo) wins over minted rows (`review_pool_migration.environment_overridable_keys`); a saved catalog, or rows minted from the owner's lanes, shadow it as disk-authored keys do. A changed delivery changes the review-contract identity (a later review may be paid anew) but launches nothing.

##### Direct-provider routes

`parse_model_route`/`llm_routing.resolve_target`: `kind@name::model` uses its `OUROBOROS_CONNECTIONS` row; missing/disabled gives `connection_unavailable`, no other key. Factory review roles (`compute_direct_review_seats`) cover each direct provider. `exclusive_direct_kind`: one, without OpenRouter, a compatible endpoint or `OPENAI_BASE_URL`. Proposals/panels (`proposal_connection`): built-in, sole named, else Main's (`main_connection_choice`); only built-in respells saved ids. Off-provider Main mints none (DEVELOPMENT "Provider Independence").

Only the official Go Chat URL (ASCII case-insensitive scheme/host, exact path) gets Ouroboros's User-Agent and model-scoped conversation ID. Go allowance is not cash. Claudexor's `opencode` Agent runs the external program.

DeepSeek (`deepseek::`) uses `DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL`; proxies/mirrors use `openai-compatible::`, `deepseek/...` stays OpenRouter. `DEEPSEEK_REASONING_EFFORT_ALIASES` maps effort; forced tools disable thinking (`llm_openai_compatible.py`). MiniMax roles use `MINIMAX_DIRECT_DEFAULTS`; saved choices stay. Move PAYG M2.7 pins before [18 Nov 2026](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/faq/models.md). Exact direct `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` maps none/minimal→low, ultra→max (`MINIMAX_FLASH_EFFORT_ALIASES`). Both report `reasoning_effort_clamped`. MiniMax `reasoning_split=true` requests reasoning, replayed verbatim same-route; details stay display-only. Live wire unverified.

Z.ai (`zai::`) is GLM on Z.ai's OpenAI-compatible API; `ZAI_PLAN` selects the endpoint (`resolve_zai_base_url`), a proxy or the China host belongs to `openai-compatible::`, `zai/...` stays OpenRouter. Z.ai serves an absent `reasoning_effort` at maximum, so the scale maps onto its enum (`ZAI_REASONING_EFFORT_ALIASES`), each tier change disclosed as `reasoning_effort_clamped`; a forced tool choice keeps its tier. HTTP 429 code 1113 is billing (also a Coding Plan key on the PAYG endpoint): Test reports `No credits`, not `Rate limited`.

GigaChat (`gigachat::`) runs on the native `gigachat` library, not the OpenAI-compatible lane, one function call per turn (`llm_gigachat.py`). `reasoning_effort` is omitted: hidden reasoning can consume the whole output budget and return empty content. With no live cost source, cost stays unknown, never a hand-maintained tariff. A GigaChat scope row retrieves on its own window (§6 Review stack).

## 8. Git Branching, CI, and Build

Branches/feeds, CI trust boundaries, keyless E2E, builds, dependency locks and release proof: seven required desktop assets and an optional Android pair. Guarantees govern published claims.

`ouroboros` is the local working branch. The runtime-selected official feed is independent: Stable = newest plain release tag reachable from both `main`/`ouroboros-stable`; QA = `ouroboros-stable` tip; Development = `ouroboros` tip (`update_channels.py`). Owner-controlled promotion and Restore bind exact SHAs; Restore preserves rescue/keep refs and never pushes. Explicit update owns fetch, validation, rescue, apply and rollback. `managed` reads/updates officially; optional `origin` persists personal work. Desktop/Colab targets need regular nonempty `BIBLE.md`. External PRs target `ouroboros` and leave versions alone (CONTRIBUTING.md).

Candidates use `candidate/<task>` and private pins (§6), published explicitly. Auto-push sends the branch and its operation-created annotated tag; selected adoption withholds both (DEVELOPMENT "The tiered commit and CI gates"). Adoption keeps that creation fact; interrupted recording leaves the tag local. Neutral commits and legacy receipts backfill none. Tag failure is disclosed, not retried.

The local `ouroboros-stable` ref is also the recovery fallback, moved by Save recovery point, `promote_to_stable`, which also pushes it, and each ready managed boot to its smoke-proved commit, apart from the QA feed. Launcher metadata is bootstrap provenance only: status, preflight, Colab bootstrap and apply resolve the selected channel and exact fetched SHA themselves: an older frozen launcher cannot redirect updates. QA and Development admit without comparing versions.

#### CI topology

Keyless `post-merge.yml` coalesces `ouroboros` pushes; merges don't wait. Linux/WAL and Windows/PERSIST retry affected reds once; Linux adds ruff F, size vs base, cost (8min k=30; k=100 opt-in). RED stands; blame needs terminal evidence. Probes omit the incomparable fixture. Stage/cost gaps and xfails differ. Per-OS `post-merge-red` issues notify culprit PRs; IDs clear on pass (size: same base) or non-size removal.

| Tier | Jobs | Trust boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Context PRs | `context-gate.yml` | Keyless `scripts/context_gate.py` |
| Read-only checks | `lint` (ruff F, ESLint, Pages), `shard-plan` → `quick-test` (PERSIST, 3 shards), `sqlite-floor` (SQLite 3.37.2), `betterleaks-platform-smoke`, `benchmark-methodology` | `lint`, `quick-test` gate releases; `benchmark-methodology` also on tags; others on dispatch. No provider secrets |
| Android source/build proof | `android-test` | `release` runs and tags; `android/tests`, release tests and disposable-key APK compilation; no publisher secrets |
| Android emulator proof | `android-emulator-smoke` | Tags or verified `android/` changes; install/start and same-UID PackageInstaller readback on an x86_64 API matrix; no publisher secrets |
| Browser consumer proof | `ui-browser.yml`, called by `ci.yml` and `ui-browser-push.yml` | Full lane for manual/tag qualification; the manual entry adds partial diagnostics. Tags/dispatch never take the documentation-only skip. The `ui-shard` jobs and `ui-manifest` share the frozen plan; `ui-smoke` reconciles shards against that manifest and rejects red sessions. No schedule, no provider secrets |
| Linux command memory | `linux-command-memory.yml` | Path-filtered PRs, manual |
| Opt-in lanes, no schedule | `system-e2e-mock` (keyless; manual runs and `v*` tags, on the release bar), `e2e-live` (`OUROBOROS_E2E_LIVE_OPENROUTER_KEY`, `$30` cap) | `e2e-live` starts only from a dispatch that opts in through the `e2e_live` input; without the secret it is one summary line and green, never a pretend run. Both upload their servers' journals, never a settings file |
| Ordinary desktop tests | `shard-plan` → `full-test-runs`, `journal-persist` → `full-test` (no secrets) | `shard-plan` names the legs: three OSes on a tag or the `release` default; `scope=tests` (per PR) runs Ubuntu + Windows, macOS on the `macos` input, `journal-persist` on Ubuntu and `lint`, nothing else; the matrix in WAL (shipped Python), `journal-persist`'s store-holding modules in PERSIST. `ci_retry.py` wraps each `run_tests.py` pass. Whole-file shards (Ubuntu/macOS 4, Windows 8) pack by the run's frozen plan. Shard 1 per OS collects unsharded manifests and runs node, size, import and Windows Chromium checks (empty/skipped fails). `full-test` reconciles both passes per OS; a red session counts only via a FLAKY/ACCEPTED verdict; only parent calls count as duplicates |
| Trusted skill matrix | `skill-smoke` (`OPENROUTER_API_KEY`) | Manual runs and `v*` tags; never pull requests |
| Trusted provider runs | `integration-test` (required), `integration-optional`; body in `provider-canary.yml` | Manual/tag callers pick disjoint markers by `credential_required`; the manual wrapper keeps `all`. Producers stay strict: optional RED may redden the workflow but blocks no release (no floor); required skips/missing block official tags. Pre-tag qualification reads every required job and canary, not aggregate green. No PRs/schedule; explicit secrets only (Google/Anthropic/OpenAI via OpenRouter: own key) |
| Tag-only gates and release chain | `release-preflight` checks only the tag, so `build` starts beside the tests. `release` needs every test and smoke lane, `lint`, the builds, `windows-proof` and `test-verdict`; Android proofs gate its optional pair; `vendor-package-smoke` is informational | No tag waives a lane. FLAKY and ACCEPTED tests (DEVELOPMENT "Flaky and accepted tests") are green and listed in the notes. Required provider failures or inconclusive skips block publication |

Quick/full `size_ratchet` checks exact manifests and shrink-only transitions against `OURO_SIZE_RATCHET_BASE_REF` (local warnings). Unresolvable bases use the tree-verified parent; missing manifests fail without borrowing debt. Only book checks skip without an event base. `scripts/book_growth_mode.py` derives `OURO_BOOK_GROWTH_MODE` (`block|warn|approved`) from PR metadata (`pull-requests: read`; DEVELOPMENT "Documentation contract"). Both run full Node (`preflight_node.py`). Skill smoke uses dependency-only Python. Reap key-bearing tree before enable. Review precedes downloaded imports; payload code never shares credentials. Procedure: DEVELOPMENT "Pytest marker lanes" and "Safe local verification and dirty browser candidates"; CI uploads only redacted evidence.

Shared UI and keyless wait/repair browser fixtures run the dirty Git candidate in an independent checkout (`tests/candidate_checkout.py`; proof of what is served: DEVELOPMENT "Safe local verification and dirty browser candidates").

Tool-schema compatibility has two layers. Local and manual/tag tests build the complete shipped catalog without MCP or extensions, validate every schema as JSON Schema plus the cross-provider subset, and need every provider projection to keep every tool name. Trusted `integration-test` sends that full registry, fitted to the route's schema ceiling as Main does, in one bounded, unexecuted `delegate_start` canary per route and needs positive usage, exact provider/model identity and a schema-valid call carrying exactly the requested arguments; quota, 429, 5xx and timeout outcomes stay typed inconclusive, while contract, auth, model, tool and reasoning 4xx are red (DEVELOPMENT "Provider Independence").

`tests/ci_evidence.py` binds timeout callbacks to run/worker/test; the gate reads crash rows, not stdout as cause. `tests/stack_samples.py` uses GIL-held samples instead of the crash-prone native watchdog; GIL-holding native hangs remain unsampled. Reports: DEVELOPMENT "Reading CI failure evidence".

`claudexor-platform-gate.yml` keeps path-filtered branch/PR triggers, tags and dispatch. It proves the managed runtime on three OSes: a fixture lane (fake harness, offline, $0) and a toolchain lane (`scripts/claudexor_toolchain_smoke.py`: production `ensure_cli_command()` installs pinned Node/npm, no ambient toolchain) always, a Windows consumer lane where shared maintenance installs vendor Codex (selected-version receipt, direct launch and doctor agree; no login or task), and a live lane only on explicit API keys. Fixture triggers also run on three OSes, credential-free: `scripts/claudexor_lifecycle_smoke.py` (pinned engine, production custody: cancel, daemon-kill respawn, completion and retirement settle and continue; no vendor sessions or child-process containment) and `scripts/claudexor_quit_witness.py` (dispatch `quit_witness_base`: base replay). `desktop-window.yml` measures a real Windows window without and with the fit (§3). `dependency-graph.yml` submits the `ouroboros/claudexor_runtime_pin.json` runtime relationship to GitHub's dependency graph (`contents: write` only) without presenting Claudexor as a Python or Node package. `.github/workflows/scorecard.yml` runs on `main` pushes and weekly, pins every action by commit SHA, defaults permissions to read-only and adds only `security-events: write` + `id-token: write`. `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` owns community rules, `CITATION.cff` the software and technical-report citations, `site/paper/index.html` the paper landing page, `docs/benchmarks/evidence.json` the release-bound public benchmark projection; README stays the claim SSOT.

`scripts/` operator/release tools: `safe_test.py` (stdlib verification boundary), `book_growth_mode.py` (contribution growth mode), `browser_ci_scope.py` (docs-only browser selection), `run_tests.py` (test battery), `ci_browser_install.py` (UI lanes, `docker-ui-smoke`, `e2e-live`: bounded, one retry, one dpkg run), `ci_shard_plan.py`, `ci_retry.py`, `post_merge_check.py`, `post_merge_bisect.py`, `run_external_review.py` (staged/`--contributor` review; evidence only), `contributor_review_evidence.py`, `run_plan_review.py` (the `plan_task` engine; review-exempt), `validate_scope_receipt.py`, `claudexor_platform_smoke.py`, `claudexor_toolchain_smoke.py`, `fetch_claudexor_runtime.py`/`download_node_standalone.py` (pin SSOT: `claudexor_runtime_pin.json`), `cleanup_test_pollution.py` (dry-run first). `site/` holds public Vite source (`site/scripts/sync-assets.mjs`); `skills/` bundles skills (`skills/builtin.json`); `packaging/cli/`, `packaging/appimage/` and `packaging/systemd/` hold CLI wrappers/installers, AppRun dispatch and the opt-in user unit (§1 Runtime topology).

#### System E2E suite (`tests/system_e2e/`)

The deep-integration suite drives a real isolated `server.py` per scenario (`KeylessIsolatedServer`, whose child environment can never carry a provider credential) and asserts durable artifacts through `ArtifactOracle` readers (the task store, `logs/*.jsonl`, `state/*`), never an HTTP 200 or a harness exit code. Synchronization is durable-event polling, never bare sleeps; a scenario that must act mid-round holds the loopback model on an event-gated `ModelGate`. Two loopback models share one HTTP base: `ScriptedStubModel`, an ordered per-scenario tool script whose review-organ calls are classified by prompt markers, and `ReplayModel`, deterministic keyed fixtures where a miss or an unconsumed row is red. A default-lane pin greps the prompt markers back out of their source files verbatim, so drift is a named failure, not a silently mute stub. Reviewer routing is pinned through an `OUROBOROS_SUBAGENTS` catalog (`keyless_review_catalog`), because a never-configured catalog reads the factory reviewers, live routes that block keyless runs. `FakeClaudexorDaemon` imitates the exact `gateways/claudexor.py` client contract and records every wire request.

The scenario inventory (`SCENARIOS` in `harness.py`) binds the package's `test_*.py` modules both ways; missing rows or tests fail. S41 checks the skill-smoke author; S43 is the load stand (`test_stand_server.py`; full shape `OUROBOROS_E2E_DEEP=stand_full`). Scenario tests carry `integration` (shared-resource cases also `serial`) and their `OUROBOROS_E2E_DEEP` lane gate, so neither the default local run nor either CI pytest pass executes them: keyless `mock` is `OUROBOROS_E2E_DEEP=mock pytest tests/system_e2e/ -o addopts=""`, in CI `system-e2e-mock`; S39's operator-run `container` lane needs one named Docker daemon (`test_managed_container.py` docstring). The paid owner-shaped stand against a real provider is operator tooling: `devtools/e2e_live/README.md`.

#### Build scripts

Build owners: `build.sh` (.dmg), `build_linux.sh` (.AppImage/.tar.gz), `scripts/build_appimage.sh`, `scripts/build_linux_packages.sh` (.deb/.rpm/.red80.rpm), `scripts/smoke_linux_packages.sh` (hosted RED OS: `scripts/ci_redos_image.py` loads `scripts/redos-ubi8.pin` with registry-only TLS trust), `build_windows.ps1` (.zip), `scripts/pack_windows_archive.ps1` (keeps hidden files), `scripts/sign_windows_release.ps1` (eSigner; `windows_signing_catalog.json`), `scripts/verify_windows_signature.ps1` (signer/timestamp), and `scripts/build_repo_bundle.py` (writes `repo.bundle` + `repo_bundle_manifest.json`, validated by `launcher.py`). Needs annotated `v$(cat VERSION)` at `HEAD`.

Native Linux: Ubuntu 22.04 x86_64, portable Python; other builders keep the host backend (`OUROBOROS_BUNDLE_LINUX_GTK=auto|0|1`; release needs `1`). `scripts/bundle_linux_gtk.py` stages GTK3/WebKitGTK 4.1, typelibs, helpers and resources in `_internal/linux-gtk`. `Ouroboros` saves caller state, then starts `Ouroboros.bin` with GUI loader paths. `desktop_media.prepare_linux_bundle` restores GI paths/cwd after frozen hooks; `host_environment` restores copies for server/host children. Source handoff keeps GUI state; both interpreters carry GI. `scripts/capture_linux_sources.py` keeps exact Debian sources, edits and hashes in production/diagnostics; recipient access stays a release obligation. Digest-pinned AppImage/packages share payload/entry; packages use `/opt/ouroboros` and an inactive opt-in user unit. Gating package smokes install via `apt`/`dnf` on Ubuntu 22.04/Fedora 42. Astra Linux/RED OS vendor smokes are informational: registry availability cannot block publication.

Before signing, builds give each bundled `playwright/driver/node` the pin’s verified Node and `LICENSE.node` (macOS: in the Resources mirror only; Android provisioning: its venv).

Betterleaks: packages stage the pinned binary/license in `betterleaks-standalone`; source checkouts explicitly install the managed runtime. Publish never downloads it (§6 Skill publication).

Embedded Python/managed updates use `requirements-runtime.lock` (pip); `requirements.txt` redirects older updaters. Both interpreters need desktop extras: source cannot import frozen PYZ. Archive smokes probe plain Python with `-I -B`; DMG also probes its app entry. Missing display/backend keeps browser fallback. Native qualification: DEVELOPMENT "Release proof capsule".

Unchecked-hash Python bytecode and external runtime caches keep the bundle signature. macOS `build.sh` compiles `packaging/macos/ouroboros_shell.c` before pruning headers, linking the matching `Frameworks/python-standalone/lib` libpython. The Contents/MacOS entry keeps source Python's app identity. Deep signing precedes its explicit app identifier, then outer sealing/verification. Signing is not launch proof: builds drop `*.dSYM`/pyobjc tests (unticketed debug companions fail Gatekeeper); proof checks the stapled, copied-out app.

`scripts/release_proof.py` checks the final DMG/AppImage/tarball/ZIP: staging checks cannot prove what the published bytes run. Each platform shard checks the embedded repo bundle, packaged CLI and Claudexor seed + Node: start the owned daemon, complete a fixture task, verify its identity-bound stop. The proven Linux tarball supplies all three native packages; each has a digest-bound package-manager smoke receipt and provenance attestation. The release job needs seven desktop assets, admits a verified optional Android pair, recalculates digests, records actual job conclusions in the checksum/evidence capsule and rechecks the remote annotated tag before publication. Signing credentials stay step-scoped and absent from SBOM/attestation steps.

Signing states, receipts and setup: DEVELOPMENT "Apple signing & notarization (macOS Build job)" and "Windows Authenticode release signing (SSL.com eSigner)". macOS prereleases build unsigned; Windows uses a fresh `windows-release-signing` Environment runner on tag pushes and reruns only.

`ouroboros/tools/release_sync.py::RELEASE_ASSET_TEMPLATES` is the installer filename SSOT of the proof builder, README and install pages. A version bump rewrites only named download references and `data-release-download` anchors to immutable `/releases/download/v{VERSION}/...` URLs; `/releases/latest/download/...` is forbidden: GitHub's `latest` skips prereleases. A development marker (BIBLE P9) rewrites none, takes no tag, build or row; links wait for the cut. Release notes link only proof-accepted assets; the APK alone is not the runtime. The default README, Pages (`main:/docs`) and Homebrew tap use the stable `main` boundary. Promotion (`scripts/promote_stable.py`) follows desktop publication, so `main` shows no dead links and an omitted promotion leaves the previous release public; it refuses until `ouroboros` holds the tag and links under a greater marker; one atomic push fast-forwards `ouroboros-stable` to a tag it lacks and appends to `main` the tag's tree plus `Casks/ouroboros.rb`, merging the tag unless `main` contains it; the Stable resolver and mirrors trace it to the tag.

`scripts/build_android_release.py` binds a source archive, a common Git seed and a publisher-signed reference APK to the tag SHA, package/version/certificate and smoke/SBOM/attestation proof. Android is nonblocking: a failed, cancelled or skipped build, a partial pair or a failed digest/smoke/SBOM/attestation check excludes both Android artifacts, while required desktop failures stay fatal. Compilation certifies no physical root, boot, hardware or runtime behavior.

#### Docker

Docker runs the web and server runtime without PyWebView, bound to `0.0.0.0` (exposure, passwords and both modes: DEPLOYMENT); `--target managed` hosts the common launcher over a released seed, body and `--runtime-venv` on volumes (§2 Packaged seed).

The root `.dockerignore` keeps secrets and local state out of `COPY . .` layers; `.git`, `tests/` and sources stay for CI's in-image pytest.

`Dockerfile` owns the image contents and cached layer order; Playwright finds the shipped browsers in `/ms-playwright` (`PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH`). No runtime `UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT` is baked, or an agent's `uv sync` in a task workspace would rewrite the runtime venv; the tag-only `docker-ui-smoke` and `docker-portable-test` lanes exercise the shipped browsers without a download. Interpreter, healthcheck, root Chromium refusal, trust anchors (none baked): DEPLOYMENT.

## 9. Shutdown & Process Cleanup

Signals, timeouts and engine terminal facts prove no OS exit; jobs stay until return. Cold receipts grant custody, not Resume or survival (§6). Switching restores stopped handles; boot retries unconfirmed custody.

Server startup raises descriptor capacity for per-run transports (`server_process.raise_open_file_limit`; platform rules and failures: its docstring).

#### Shutdown doors

| Door | Stops | Keeps | Durable mark |
|---|---|---|---|
| Desktop close, keep-running on, live indicator | none: window hides, on macOS only after full screen's DidExit | all tasks, schedules, companions and daemon | none |
| Close, quit, SIGTERM, launcher gone (pipe EOF, POSIX too) | this generation's workers, maintenance child, services, owned executor/task processes and unfinished reviews | shared daemon/clients unless Quit; saved pauses; saved work held for Resume | `shutdown_entry.json`, then `server_shutdown.cause`: `external_signal`, `launcher_quit` or `launcher_gone` |
| Planned restart (self-restart, update) | same; off-pin daemon unless newer | saved pauses; saved work/cut owner turns/runnable queue, returned; same-pin or newer daemon | restart handoff, then `shutdown_entry.json` |
| Manual Restart (owner) | same; its own delegated runs end | as Planned restart (§3) | restart transaction `door=owner_restart`, `shutdown_entry.json` |
| Panic | all owned work | sleeping work: owner Resume; working: saved for Resume after launch; pauses unchanged | `panic_stop.flag` (`panic`), then `panic_ingress_receipt` |
| Fault (`bus_lost`, `loop_failed`; §5) | as Close; kept work's delegated runs end | as Close; unsaved rows `cancelled` | as Close, cause named; a `supervisor_failure` row, then the startup notice and one recovery turn per died generation (facts `recovery_turn_facts.py`); exit 1 under a launcher, else census and re-exec (`server_process.fault_exit`); Panic owns exit; never 42/99 |

**Desktop.** `launcher_background.py`: unset choice asks/saves once. Quit never asks, cancels, sets or overtakes Panic; both latch startup/handoff shut. Only an owner's Quit (desktop gesture or accepted headless signal) ends the owned engine and its clients' runs before PID-lock release (`QuitEngineStop`). Early Quit (macOS app quit too, which a logout awaits; closing the Git or Startup Failed window unless keep-running is saved) closes setup windows, stops captured/bootstrap children (as does tray/window Panic) and identity-proven servers, sparing stale companions. Non-daemon `execute_panic_stop` persists/exits. Windows owns Popen until transfer; Panic never waits. New source checks inherited parent exit; old source/failed inheritance leaves late spawn unproved. POSIX captures descendants before orphaning; timeouts give no total bound. Windows keeps Job-error fallback. No HTTP/callback/replay; failures disclosed. Android loopback: `/api/command /panic`; second launch opens during boot; Linux closes normally.

`launcher.stop_agent` sends private-stdin `quit\n` (`OUROBOROS_LAUNCHER_STOP_STDIN`, all platforms; else SIGTERM), waits `LAUNCHER_STOP_GRACE_SEC`, then forces group/Job cleanup, retaining handle/record until confirmed exit. Quit/EOF/signals latch stop at once; group signals still complete custody. `SERVER_GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_SEC` bounds Uvicorn drain; backstops fire after the launcher grace (a stop exits 1; a fault, its door). `_exit_signalled` stays set against settings-save revival; new lifespans clear `_supervisor_stop`.

Commands enter `executable_main()`: signals latch stop for the serving loop, preserving cleanup joins. Final exit bypasses capture joins; signals return `128+signal`, Panic owns exit.

#### Restart and retention

Teardown marks its generation, bounded-joins the supervisor and stops workers before optional waits; the watcher owns handoff. `owned_shutdown.stop_owned_work` shares first-door grace, event-log locks included (§10 invariant 6); unconfirmed custody retains `unconfirmed_since` for retry before admission. Pin rule: `server_restart._stop_owned_daemon_for_new_pin`. After stop evidence, `store_switch.switch_at_restart` exports/retires storage and moves the checkout; boot recovers uncertain intent. Returns need launcher exit 42 or a locked one-shot successor: same-PID exec, custodied POSIX spawn, Windows original-parent HANDLE exit 42 with measured births. Only that successor returns work/queue; undispatched wait/planned carriers keep transaction gates; failed binding holds work with Panic available; unconsumed Windows handles leave re-upgrade unqualified. Listeners end with the server; companions use PID/reserved-port custody (§12), never port sweeps.

Manual Restart (`server_restart._perform_owner_restart`) refuses conflicts/unwritable transactions before teardown. Its `door=owner_restart`, `status=prepared`, generation/PID stop same-generation starts without Panic. `prepare_restart_returns` names returns; boot consumes only prior-generation doors after holds/`record_restart`, setting `door_applied_at` independently of ACK. Legacy flags/bytes translate once to this boot's door. Teardown retains saves, reads attach-only custody (never ensuring a daemon) and keeps unconfirmed cleanup visible, without veto.

**Retention.** `restart_retention.py` keeps pauses, revokes unused grants and yields spent carriers to newer continuation custody. Warm owner Pause converts to cold; acknowledged planned/update sleep returns, manual Restart holds it. Doors replace only `saved_sleep_recovery` and `continuation_writer_unsettled`; stronger prior stops survive, even Panic. Panic gives sleeping work `panic_hold`/owner, working work `saved_work_hold{door:panic}`/resume; stored release never changes retrospectively. Source/money/time/Stop still govern; unknown dispatch is not unstarted. Rollback loses Q9 checks; old launchers may need the removed Restart flag (PERSISTENCE).

#### Panic path

Panic latches at ingress; a failed thread start runs it synchronously. Owned stops (restart successor too) precede bounded persistence and installation census, daemon or not; the executing process, parent and pid 1 are spared. Census follows observed Panic exit or local tray/window Panic; the indicator leaves without waiting. Boot retries only saved pid/birth pairs in `state/panic_sweep_pending.json`; a flag grants no new discovery, so undiscovered work is missed; stopping old controllers may affect new attachments. Diagnostic faults spare other stop owners; failed writes cannot prevent exit 99, which authorizes no successor. Worker socket grace, lifelines and parent kills have separate bounds; lane carriers die by measured identity like any worker, an inline executor's pid-less slot by a cooperative stop only. Requests prove no exit; inaccessible/unpublished/backend-only children stay unconfirmed. WS/HTTP uses `LocalChatBridge.panic` without supervisor I/O; Host Service authenticates skill and pinned owner (§12). Only installation gates read `installation_stop.py` (Panic bytes and file identity; boot order, receipt, failures and repeats: its docstring).

Browser Panic sends once on its captured open socket with no buffered output; `panic_accepted` means latch, not exit. No confirmation, upload/save wait, replay or clock check; sent bytes may arrive late. `panic_source.py` keeps its causal evidence (docstring). Unknown PIDs stay unknown; diagnostics neither authorize nor veto.

Local tray/window Panic bypasses the observed-99 `kill_runtime_orphans` finalizer, which signals saved companion PIDs/ports without fresh identity proof. Escaped companions with unreadable/absent scope markers remain unconfirmed by captured trees and census (§12).

#### Owned daemon stop and startup failure

`OwnedClaudexorDaemon.stop_outcome`: `stopped`, `nothing_to_stop`, `unconfirmed`. Owned marker + authenticated same-home `daemon stop --json` requires exit 0 and terminal receipt, not RPC/lease ACK. Forced signals use pre-request birth/command or the manager's Popen; only confirmed death retires custody (DEVELOPMENT "Process Custody Rule"). Lock/RPC/exit bounds are separate, not a total. Past `CLAUDEXOR_STARTUP_WAIT_SEC`: live child `daemon_starting`, silent listener `daemon_not_answering`, exited child `daemon_spawn_failed`.

**Startup failure.** `claudexor_startup_failure.py` classifies child `daemon.log`: `heap_exhausted`, `writer_lease_contended`, `engine_floor`, `unclassified`; carriers: `daemon_spawn_failed`, `last_error`, one `claudexor_daemon_start_failed` row. Only `ExitFact.failed_without_control` latches spawning. Live attach/new manager clears it; server custody sweep (§5) clears, then ensures once without waiting. Owner Refresh (`/api/claudexor/wake`, one spawn/press) or Restart Claudexor (§3) releases; workers need attach/respawn. Record `claudexor_daemon_start_latch_cleared`/`cleared_by`. Probe `launch.nodeArgs` supplies `--max-old-space-size`; explicit `NODE_OPTIONS` wins; absent/malformed keeps the plain command (`runtime_launch_invalid`).

`claudexor_exit_facts.py` reads a bounded `supervisor.jsonl` tail: saved exits use observation time, not death time; context never calls the engine. Authenticated `/api/claudexor/status` adds live `memory`, `loop`, `store`, `servingMode`, effective `capacity`, class `admission`; missing measurements are null, finite/unlimited/unknown caps distinct. Settings → Accounts and keys (§3) retains one dated `claudexor_engine_capacity` snapshot per descriptor generation beside fresh observations/stale facets; none grants lifecycle authority. Custody sweep (§5) writes changed per-route failure shares alone to `claudexor_route_health` and the vitals/deep-review file (`record_route_health`; PERSISTENCE).

Claudexor 4 import can leave an authenticated daemon `recovery_only` for minutes. `ensure_owned_gateway` waits `CLAUDEXOR_ADMISSION_WAIT_SEC`, then refuses `daemon_recovery_only` without killing; passive status shows migration. Storage/forward-only compatibility/logical and physical quarantine: PERSISTENCE. External-host CLI/MCP attach only; this manager owns start/stop; standalone installs own theirs.

#### Process custody

`state/owned_processes.json`: task executor (§1) and process ledger index; contention queues in `owned_processes.pending/`. Boot indexes legacy once; Exit/Panic skip `data/state` walks. Groups/Jobs miss escapees. `end_owned_processes` follows descendants/launch markers, never task markers/daemon roots (unknown roots held): persist survivors before signals, require measured identity/exit, hold the name through capture. `launch_custody.py` reads ledger+copies across workers (unreadable→unknown); session-scope kept services: one launch-ID/reason Stop via the exit routine and fresh read. Owner: Activity; root: `stop_service(service_id=)` after proven producer completion. A kept start's `kept_outputs/<task>/<launch>.kept.json` (no-output: by its log) records outputs/capture context; outside Stop saves to the producer's store, not the stopper's. Logs wait for writer exit and verified custody (PERSISTENCE); Activity Save outputs retries capture. Startup retries stamped stops, not executor settlement. Docker: persist `backend_completed` before marker deletion; CLI exit proves no backend exit; lost replies retain evidence, never signal completed CLI PIDs. `docker_process_observer.py` reads `/proc`: zombies exited, return code unknown; stop/writer fences need no live group member; unreadable stat: unknown. Host unwind/exact worker death retires only its local invocation (§6).

Only a measured birth/command mismatch retires other owned custody, journalled first as `process_not_ours` with both fingerprints; a foreign leader's EPERM, a reused non-leader, unreadable identity or a failed signal proves nothing and keeps the stop.

**Work scopes** (`process_scope.py`): pre-spawn installation marker survives in daemon, kept services, MCP and extension children/companions; task markers do not, except task-session MCP. Invocation identity, never labels, binds commands/task skills/non-kept services to markers/groups. Terminal transitions alone end leftovers by measured birth, not Pause/hold/handoff/placeholders. Retire on recorded settlement (signal denial final) or `unsupported`; unknown identity remains owed. Panic's schema-1 `daemon/run-scopes.json` needs absent/valid index for full settlement; markers/births stay independent. Limits: leaderless recycled groups may pass reuse checks; Linux nondumpable/setuid peers and macOS system binaries hide markers; GUI children have no exemption; Windows/Docker-executor children stay `unsupported`.

**Follow-up controls** (§5): `followup_policy` puts recorded cancel intent above door cause; failed transfer retains it; unreadable stores invent no control; Panic needs no schedule control.

#### Test runs

Lanes/`safe_test`: `ProcessContainer`, scrubbed roots (`test_environment.py`); a passed test's `tmp_path` goes after its processes, a marker keeps its folder; private-copy records join its task (PERSISTENCE).


## 10. Key Invariants

Cross-cutting owners and the continuity map: exact sources, working views and authority.

1. **Constitution and identity persist.** Outside Cyber Pro neither `BIBLE.md` nor `identity.md` is deleted; content evolves.
2. **Release metadata has one projection.** `VERSION` is canonical; `ouroboros/tools/release_sync.py::VERSION_CARRIER_SPANS` names carriers, `sync_release_metadata()` writes and `version_carrier_desyncs()` checks them. Which commits carry a number and which stay neutral is BIBLE P9.
3. **Configuration and messaging have single owners.** `ouroboros/config.py` is the one import surface for paths and settings; the vocabularies live in its leaves `settings_defaults` (keys, shipped defaults, dropped-key lists), `settings_scales` (clamps), `model_slots` (slot resolution), `review_model_routes` (reviewer lists), `runtime_limits` (numeric knobs) and `settings_integrity` (the verified read), so a new key belongs to a leaf, never to the facade (§7). Messages go through `supervisor/message_bus.py`; task-fact transitions are store transactions (`ouroboros/store.py`; `store_switch.py` owns the boot import and restart exit); other transitions use the owning file lock.
4. **The usage store is the record of spend.** `state/usage.sqlite` owns current attempts and their summaries; state, task, event and UI amounts are projections carrying attempt identity (`ouroboros/usage_store.py`).
5. **The app is a replaceable host.** A packaged install verifies `repo.bundle` and manifest once, then runs the managed checkout; Restart keeps its tip; only an explicit update applies an approved exact SHA. Host facts are re-derived each launch; owners re-point kept host paths; no tracked name is application-typed.
6. **Shutdown stops what it owns, once, within the grace** (§9). Close, restart and Fault stop executors and task-started processes in `state/owned_processes.json`, sparing the installation daemon, which only Quit, a new pin not below it, Panic or Restart Claudexor (§3) ends, by confirmed ledger identity. The first door starts grace and stamps pending stops; signals need measured identity; next boot retries recorded obligations before admission. No agent delays Panic; clients never queue or replay it. Owner: `owned_shutdown.py`.
7. **This book is the present-tense map.** A structural change updates its owning chapter in the same commit (DEVELOPMENT "Documentation contract").
8. **Skill gates do not collapse.** Discovery, deterministic preflight, content-hash-bound critic or qualified author authority, owner grants, dependency readiness, enablement and execution stay separate: neither a verdict nor `enabled=true` proves executable readiness.
9. **Startup rescue has one mutation owner.** Supervisor recovery writes rescue evidence before a reset, or blocks while preserving the tree; worker and agent construction only warn, never staging or committing inherited dirt. No `index.lock` is aged out: a refused checkout fails its operation.
10. **Current facts are stored, not re-derived.** Owning transitions publish addressed facts/obligations; history serves cognition/audits/explicit repair, never ordinary authority or answering paths. Capture coherent reads, then materialize off transaction. One current stop per scope; `current_stop` reads installation → tree → member. Release removes its record; `_resume_selection` retains choice identities, not a cause. Technical refusal, execution evidence and permission stay separate; uncertainty holds only dependent effects, visible even on terminals. Observations stay open only while a live producer can change them; outbox history follows commit. Owners: `store.py`, `usage_store.py`, `store_switch.py`, `obligations.py`, `work_stop.py`, `owned_shutdown.py`.
11. **UI resources carry a disposer.** Every subscription, listener, observer, timer, stream and live page instance has explicit teardown; navigation leaves no hidden instance mutating visible or durable state.
12. **Frozen contracts extend explicitly.** `ouroboros/contracts/` is a versioned, backward-compatible ABI of typed shapes with their parsing, normalization and policy helpers (§11); new capability extends the frozen shape or ships a versioned successor; existing consumers keep working.
13. **Provider wire adaptation stays exact-route and success-confirmed.** A typed physical projection of provider-neutral history may change values, fields or a registered dialect on one provider/endpoint/API/model only. Failed candidates teach nothing durable, task-local degradation never becomes dispatch authority, `state/usage.sqlite` stays distinct from terminal `usage.request_wire` history.
14. **Cancellation is intent-then-custody.** Intent is not canonical status. Custody mutation needs durable watchdog-replayable intent and exclusive claim. Settled results prove no dead worker; live ownership gates their cancel. Natural completion wins late cancel: custody targets the process, never the result; its stored row stays byte-identical. Owe delivery before settling intent; cascades follow lineage roots. Finals show task-addressed open runs, closing receipts and pending non-review invocations; live enqueue precedes annotation, resource release stays synchronous (§5); owners: `supervisor/task_lifecycle.py`, `ouroboros/cancel_intents.py`, `supervisor/cancel_publication.py`, `supervisor/terminal_delivery.py`, `ouroboros/delegate_terminal.py`.
15. **Cancellation registry corruption stays visible.** In `state/cancel_intents.json` and `state/terminal_deliveries.json` an absent file reads as empty; a malformed file or row is disclosed, its bytes kept; no mutation rebuilds an existing malformed store from a `{}` collapse.
16. **Verification receipts reconcile by one typed identity key.** Sameness is equality of the single (kind, value) key, never a match across kinds, so reconciliation fails safe toward fewer reconciliations; disclosed parts never compare (`_outcome_receipts.py`).
17. **Review spend has one ceiling.** Every paid review gate shares `OUROBOROS_REVIEW_MAX_CYCLES` (SSOT `review_cycles.py`; per-gate meanings: §6 Review stack); plan asks stand outside it. The ceiling never removes the last author reaction; a blocking correction or stop grants no approval.
18. **A typed permanent engine refusal discharges a custody duty once.** Durably, under the engine's own code, never retried on a timer or recorded as a deletion. A non-review registration stays while its owner line is live or reserved or its root offers Continue after an interruption (an author's stop offers it without holding); unknown authority keeps it; settlement alone grants no retirement. Owners: `delegate_custody._retire_project_locked`, `delegate_continuation.still_continuable`.
19. **An interrupted parent leaves no orphan.** Admitted children follow the parent's cancellation cause through pooled/direct teardown and snapshot restore (`kill_workers`, `pending_parent_interrupted`). Preparation-only requests have their own durable token/phase and typed never-admitted recovery (§5, `recover_interrupted_preparations`); snapshot absence alone proves no non-dispatch. Owners: `supervisor/workers.py`, `supervisor/queue_snapshot.py`, `supervisor/task_admission.py`.
20. **A stall says where it went silent.** `supervisor_loop_stall` names tick phase and lag, `supervisor_loop_stall_end` closes it with stacks; `host_duty_stall` and `direct_turn_stall` are its off-loop twins. Producers publish; only the wedge notice speaks; the journal and each `direct_turn` receipt are the record the mind reads: whether the owner hears is its judgment.
21. **Source acknowledgement is a pre-check over known facts.** A completion's owner-source acknowledgement (`acceptance_subject.owner_source_sha256`) advances only consumed ingress, never a verdict; the root admission seal's compare-and-seal stays the single fail-closed authority; an unknown queue state is disclosed, never read as a change; every refusal carries its typed cause in `acceptance_source_ack` (owners `loop_messages.py`, `delivery_seal.py`).
22. **A host-owed round never parks.** A turn parks behind a review panel only when it waits for nothing else; one where the host just spoke to the model never parks (`loop._finalize_loop_candidate`).
23. **A reviewer's tool call has a bound, and a recorder speaks only for what it collected.** It runs under the loop's per-tool timeout narrowed by the inherited dispatch deadline; one that outlives it is abandoned and its late value sources no receipt; a wave whose author no longer waits settles later from its seats' recorded answers at $0, never a re-send. Owners: `review_native_episode.py`, `loop_tool_execution.py`, `review_pause.py`.
24. **The thread that answers workers runs only queue-bounded work.** Network and preparation run off-thread. A generation-owned child maintains history. Q spans memory except at sites named by `test_queue_lock_io_inventory.py`, which drives real parks and wakes. Durable work follows release and revalidates on re-take; closing admission never pretends physical jobs ended. Idle cancel, delivery, notice and usage duties keep their claims and receipts without rereading rows (`test_cost_live_set.py`). Residuals: `dispatch_choice.py` and `pool_admission.py` docstrings (§5). Observers do not queue behind heavy collection. Current selection re-proves no unrelated completed history. Stop-time engine access is attach-only. No server thread starts a focus (task body, context build, wake preparation, Presence body) beyond the disclosed inline executors (`tests/test_executor_inventory.py` names every door, residuals included). Owners: `server_maintenance.py`, `conversation_lane.py`, `inline_carrier.py`, `tree_census.py`, `delegate_collection.py`, `sleep_custody.py`; preparation: §5.
25. **An answer that has not arrived is a gap, never a refusal, a failure, a verdict or an owner message.** When its source can be read again, saved work returns automatically through the exact grant. Panic and owner Restart require Resume. Queue admission locks before Q. Pooled attempts prove each request and publish only while current. At the seal only owner mail revises; silence or another refusal buys no round: the seal runs once, at an author stop; an unanswered one delivers with `admission_released=False` and a durable `supervisor_ack_unavailable` row; only `sealed` seals, an absent row never (§6 Result review); Presence frees its row. Owners: `ouroboros/agent.py`, `supervisor/queue_transitions.py`, `ouroboros/loop_delivery.py`.
26. **Running work stays steerable.** My human's words to a work reach its root as dialogue and every other focus of its tree at its next step or start, carried by the host as exact, dated precedence and context owing no reply, and a running external session where its route takes live input, else with its next continuation; nothing sent is rewritten, and a review keeps its verdict by its identity and one question, never by withholding those words. A change to routing, carriage, context or review identity says what each running actor receives of them, when and labelled how, and never narrows it for cache, storage or review stability. Carriage at receipt: §6. Owners: `owner_relay.py`, `owner_words.py`.
27. **One request keeps one work identity.** `move_to_project` places the current work; `start_task` creates separate work without predecessor or origin-sibling selection. The complete new-work intent is durable before emission. Boot never replays it: proven unadmitted becomes `not_started` with explicit retry, unknown admission stays held. Technical Continue keeps its own eligibility and custody contract. Owners: `project_placement.py`, `promotion_intent.py`, `tools/control_routing.py`.
28. **A display never waits on money, and paid admission never waits on history.** Paid dispatch compares known spend with the applicable limits and discloses in-flight, late overshoot and estimates separately; unknown cost shows as unknown, never zero, and never alone refuses work; displays read the same addressed records, never run the history import, and report unavailable data as such. Owners: `ouroboros/usage_accounting.py`, `ouroboros/usage_store.py`.
29. **English at the source, translation at render.** Every owner-visible string is authored in English; code enumerates no language and the repository ships no dictionary. A non-English install paints from its own translation memory (`state/i18n/<tag>.json`: generated, imported or owner-pinned), while durable rows keep English and their typed codes; model text and owner-supplied names are never translated; a string the memory lacks stays English, as does Beautiful Context (dates: device locale) (`i18n_memory.py`, `ui_translation.py`).
30. **A review subject is frozen once, read everywhere, and governed by the installed body.** What a wave reviews is a `FrozenSubject`, never the live index of the process's repository; rules, checklist and navigation come from the system repository, reviewers read the subject's own root or its isolated checkout, and every identity derives from the frozen subject: the same head with a different base is a different subject (§6 Subject operation, `tools/review_subject.py`).
31. **Saved work continues; it never repeats, outlives Stop or orphans a child.** One writer saves each attempt; recovery freezes bytes. UNKNOWN calls never re-execute; owed/delivered answers are never answered again. Acknowledged Restart returns named work; other application stops require Resume. A crash after consumed Resume with newer working state retries that state, never its old grant. Release removes the stop, not independent stops or Q9 child selection. Under Pause only already-sent reviews finish. Ended local custody needs positive proof, never `ps lstart`; returns never regress. Owners: `working_checkpoint.py`, `restart_retention.py`, `local_custody_repair.py` (invariant 19).
32. **Everything kept is a record or held.** Every byte Ouroboros or its engine keeps is a record (written once or appended, re-encoded losslessly) or held by a named holder whose end releases it; a hold derives from the current fact, never a leftover token, marker or snapshot. Each retirer pass reports what it released and its typed holds `{class, count, example, since}` (`maintenance_jobs.record_pass`, the engine's `GcHold` shape; the custody sweep records the engine's; written only on change) to Storage and the mind's `storage` fact. Owners: `maintenance_jobs.py`, `storage_removers.py` and the retirers.

Task control/phase facts (`store_hot_facts.py`) commit with the body; Stop/census read addressed columns. Hot facts and the tree census derive only from a task's own body: a bad row alone stays unknown. Card facts (`store_task_cards.py`) merge row-only in one acquisition slice, without body/signature writes; census polls the hot card. Store transactions end before display; snapshots authorize no mutation, unknown stays unknown, question details still read bodies.

#### 10.1 Continuity data-flow map

A bounded view is an interface projection, never a new authority: the deciding actor must resolve the named source through an existing reader, or the view is partial and the consumer stays non-final or abstains.

| Surface | Canonical source and owner | Bounded projection | Actor-readable source/ref | Decision and retention rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Owner authority and biography | canonical chat/archives and `memory/chronicle/records.jsonl` | room views and selected common accounts | `memory_read` exact record/revision; chat/archive readers | accounts keep non-exclusive source versions; selection seals nothing, originals stay addressable, later changes explicit; no retelling replaces governing words |
| Shared understanding and knowledge summaries | the `overview` knowledge note (`memory/knowledge/overview.md`) and each note's authored YAML `summary` | the resident `## Shared understanding` section and the whole index’s active summaries | `knowledge_read(topic=..., scope='global')`, `knowledge_list` | a missing overview renders as a visible gap line; archives stay addressable/listable (§6 Durable memory and project focus); body-only edits keep summaries |
| Execution evidence | task results, delegated message frames, observability call manifests and blobs, service logs, process-custody records | status cards, terminal rows, bounded tails, compact child summaries | exact artifact, blob and service-log refs carried by the task result or canonical promotion | a projection cannot certify a missing child or source; referenced sources and task-owned physical calls outlive child-drive GC |
| Terminal task/project memory | the root terminal result plus the task and project summary producers | Main terminal summaries and the two Project-root lifecycle rows | task-result id, project binding, summary and source refs | a summary is a biography projection, not evidence; the result review reads the frozen origin, owner words and verification receipts; failed, cancelled and degraded outcomes stay with their result owner |
| Plan/review authority | exact wave/answer artifacts, predecessor links and immutable author selections (§6 Review ledger record) | whole operative spec and current statuses; individual notes or grouped historical accounts | observed source versions, membership, lineage and task-source readers | surviving local accounts cross cold/new packets/Continue; unchanged indexes stay; notes change no verdict or paid replay; invalid transfers keep their bodies |
| Result review | the retained subject text (`result-subject-<sha16>` in the task's artifact store: the ask, the reply, produced files by path, hash and exact copy or a link's text, verification receipts) and the wave's ledger record (`surface="result"`) | the record's compact projection on the task card and in `## Review records`; the findings shown to the mind before delivery | the retained subject and each file's exact copy, read by retrieving seats, excerpted inline for packet seats; the record's `source_ref` | frozen at the call: a file without a copy is a named gap; one subject sha reuses its settled record at $0; a changed answer or material is a new subject |
| Canonical versus execution roots | canonical root: identity, authority, biography, results, promoted observability; execution drives: tools, workspace, trajectory, call manifests | project/fork/task lenses | `install_identity`, task pointers, source handles | stored paths never authorize another install; copies mint an identity, foreign tasks await explicit move; forks remain execution lenses; adoption precedes retention, which verifies `task_source` without rewriting carriers; GC cannot prove untracked late futures quiescent; missing bytes stay gaps |

Four rules the map relies on. A review subject's identity is fixed before any budgeting of what a seat reads; changed sources invalidate it; `tool_trajectory:<corpus-sha>[<source-index>]` addresses original records, never moving-tail positions. Review records and checkpoints are retained write-once (`state/review_ledger`, `source_handles/context_checkpoints`) before the compact `write_task_result` projection; a task-acceptance checkpoint stored before the result review keeps `applied_source_status`. `review_projection.late_notice_receipts` hands a late-notice duty to the existing outbox: custody, not delivery. `terminal_delivery.register_delivery` keeps the first retained receipt; `basis="send_handler_returned"` proves the send seam returned, not a human read; late evidence is judged on an admissible turn (§6 Review stack).
